sections.headingEn: Install the Windows portable package
paragraphsEn: ArSee is a Windows IEC 60870 protocol analyzer. The published package is a ZIP containing the desktop application; it is not a production SCADA server.
paragraphsId: ArSee adalah analyzer protokol IEC 60870 untuk Windows. Paket publik berupa ZIP berisi aplikasi desktop; bukan SCADA server produksi.

prerequisitesEn: A trusted release package and an ordinary writable local folder.
prerequisitesId: Paket release tepercaya dan folder lokal yang dapat ditulis.
stepsEn: Open the official ArSee GitHub Releases page and select the applicable Windows x64 release ZIP.
Extract every file to a local folder, for example C:\Tools\ArSee; do not run directly from a compressed archive.
Start ARIEC60870.exe from the extracted folder.
If SmartScreen appears, first verify the release source and checksum according to your organization policy.
stepsId: Buka GitHub Releases resmi ArSee dan pilih ZIP Windows x64 yang sesuai.
Ekstrak seluruh isi ke folder lokal, misalnya C:\Tools\ArSee; jangan menjalankan langsung dari arsip.
Jalankan ARIEC60870.exe dari folder hasil ekstraksi.
Jika SmartScreen muncul, verifikasi asal release dan checksum menurut kebijakan organisasi sebelum melanjutkan.
workflow.expectedEn: Main Window opens with Setup, Connect, Report, Open Cap, Save Cap, Trace TXT, Clear, Signals and Help in the left action rail.
workflow.expectedId: Main Window terbuka dengan Setup, Connect, Report, Open Cap, Save Cap, Trace TXT, Clear, Signals dan Help pada action rail kiri.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If the executable will not launch, verify extraction, Windows compatibility and organizational application restrictions; do not bypass company security controls blindly.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika executable tidak terbuka, periksa hasil ekstraksi, kompatibilitas Windows dan kebijakan aplikasi organisasi; jangan menonaktifkan kontrol keamanan sembarangan.

sections.headingEn: Read the window in three areas
paragraphsEn: The left action rail starts and stops the session. The center contains selectable investigation workspaces. The right side provides a collapsible Command Panel for IEC 101/104 operations.
paragraphsId: Action rail kiri mengatur sesi. Bagian tengah berisi workspace analisis yang dapat dipilih. Sisi kanan memiliki Command Panel lipat untuk operasi IEC 101/104.

stepsEn: Inspect the left rail: Setup opens configuration; Connect toggles to Disconnect during a running active session.
Use the central workspace navigation: Raw Frames, Values, Events, Controls, GI, Report, and other views appropriate to the selected protocol.
Click the slim COMMAND PANEL header/chevron when you actually need GI, Read IOA or supported control actions.
Use Help or F1 to open context-sensitive instructions for the selected workspace.
stepsId: Perhatikan action rail kiri: Setup membuka konfigurasi; Connect berubah menjadi Disconnect selama sesi aktif.
Gunakan navigasi workspace tengah: Raw Frames, Values, Events, Controls, GI, Report, dan view lain sesuai protokol.
Klik header/chevron COMMAND PANEL yang ramping hanya saat memerlukan GI, Read IOA atau kontrol yang didukung.
Gunakan Help atau F1 untuk membuka instruksi kontekstual sesuai workspace yang dipilih.
workflow.expectedEn: You can reach the trace and evidence workspaces without opening the command dock or adding visual clutter.
workflow.expectedId: Trace dan workspace evidence bisa digunakan tanpa membuka command dock atau menambah keramaian layar.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Some workspaces hide or change labels in Passive Monitor or Dual Link mode; this is intentional profile-specific navigation.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Sebagian workspace tersembunyi atau berubah nama pada mode Passive Monitor atau Dual Link; ini navigasi sesuai profil.

sections.headingEn: First safe practice in built-in demo
sections.headingId: Latihan aman pertama dengan demo bawaan
paragraphsEn: Built-in demo simulation is an explicit per-run choice. Saved demo settings are deliberately not automatically restored as the next startup target.
paragraphsId: Demo simulation bawaan adalah pilihan eksplisit per sesi. Pengaturan demo yang tersimpan sengaja tidak otomatis dipakai sebagai target startup berikut.

prerequisitesEn: No production control cable or live breaker is needed.
prerequisitesId: Tidak memerlukan kabel kontrol produksi maupun breaker hidup.
stepsEn: Click Setup, select IEC 60870-5-104 or another suitable supported lab profile.
In TARGET MODE choose Built-in demo simulation, not Real device / server.
Review protocol and address widths, then use Setup's Connect action.
Inspect Raw Frames, Values and Events. When done, click Disconnect.
For real commissioning, reopen Setup and explicitly verify that TARGET MODE is Real device / server.
stepsId: Klik Setup, pilih IEC 60870-5-104 atau profil lab lain yang didukung.
Pada TARGET MODE pilih Built-in demo simulation, bukan Real device / server.
Periksa protokol dan ukuran field address, lalu gunakan Connect dalam Setup.
Lihat Raw Frames, Values dan Events. Setelah selesai klik Disconnect.
Untuk commissioning riil, buka Setup lagi dan pastikan TARGET MODE adalah Real device / server.
workflow.expectedEn: A simulated IEC session is clearly separated from a connection to an external RTU; demo values are not field FAT evidence.
workflow.expectedId: Sesi IEC simulasi jelas terpisah dari koneksi RTU eksternal; nilai demo bukan evidence FAT lapangan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If expected demo data are absent, check the selected mode and workspace; do not infer a real-device fault from the internal simulator.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika data demo tidak terlihat, periksa mode dan workspace; jangan menyimpulkan kegagalan perangkat lapangan dari simulator internal.

sections.headingEn: The basic investigation workflow
paragraphsEn: Work from observable bytes toward engineering conclusions. Never interpret a connected indicator as proof of a finished GI, spontaneous event delivery, or physical breaker feedback.
paragraphsId: Mulai dari byte yang teramati menuju kesimpulan engineering. Indikator connected bukan bukti GI selesai, event spontan terkirim, atau feedback breaker fisik.

stepsEn: Choose the protocol and target in Setup; check the device interoperability profile.
Connect or start monitoring; confirm RX/TX or captured byte evidence in Raw Frames.
Correlate decoded addresses, Type/COT and quality with Values and Events.
Use Controls and GI views for lifecycle evidence where supported.
Select useful raw/evidence rows and save a capture or create a PDF report.
Disconnect or Stop Monitor before changing cables or changing the connection profile.
stepsId: Pilih protokol dan target di Setup; periksa interoperability profile perangkat.
Connect atau mulai monitoring; pastikan evidence byte RX/TX pada Raw Frames.
Cocokkan address, Type/COT dan quality yang di-decode dengan Values dan Events.
Gunakan view Controls dan GI untuk evidence lifecycle bila didukung.
Pilih baris raw/evidence yang relevan lalu simpan capture atau buat report PDF.
Disconnect atau Stop Monitor sebelum mengganti kabel atau profil koneksi.
workflow.expectedEn: A useful result links transport, decoded application data and independently verified process meaning.
workflow.expectedId: Hasil yang berguna menghubungkan transport, data aplikasi terdecode, dan makna proses yang diverifikasi independen.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: When a step lacks trace evidence, mark it not observed rather than claiming device failure or success.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika suatu tahap tidak mempunyai evidence trace, tandai not observed, jangan langsung menyimpulkan perangkat gagal atau sukses.

sections.headingEn: Select exactly the intended protocol mode
paragraphsEn: The PROTOCOL PROFILE dropdown offers IEC 103 serial, IEC 101 serial, IEC 101 Dual Link, IEC 101 Passive Monitor and IEC 104 TCP/IP. These are distinct workflows; changing the dropdown changes relevant controls.
paragraphsId: Dropdown PROTOCOL PROFILE menyediakan IEC 103 serial, IEC 101 serial, IEC 101 Dual Link, IEC 101 Passive Monitor dan IEC 104 TCP/IP. Alur kerjanya berbeda; pemilihan mode mengubah kontrol yang relevan.

stepsEn: Open Setup in the left rail.
Select the precise desired mode in PROTOCOL PROFILE.
Read the protocol description card and check whether Serial Connection or IEC-104 TCP/IP Access is visible.
Choose TARGET MODE Real device / server for an approved live endpoint, or Built-in demo simulation for a test fixture.
Review remaining controls before clicking Connect.
stepsId: Buka Setup pada action rail kiri.
Pilih mode persis pada PROTOCOL PROFILE.
Baca kartu deskripsi protokol dan periksa apakah Serial Connection atau IEC-104 TCP/IP Access tampil.
Pilih TARGET MODE Real device / server untuk endpoint live yang disetujui, atau Built-in demo simulation untuk fixture tes.
Periksa seluruh kontrol sebelum menekan Connect.
workflow.expectedEn: Only settings applicable to the selected protocol are emphasized; unused controls are hidden or disabled.
workflow.expectedId: Hanya pengaturan yang relevan dengan protokol diprioritaskan; kontrol yang tidak berlaku disembunyikan atau dinonaktifkan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Do not interpret a previous demo configuration as an automatically active real-device target.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jangan menganggap konfigurasi demo sebelumnya otomatis menjadi target riil yang aktif.

sections.headingEn: Configure serial framing and flow control
sections.headingId: Konfigurasi framing serial dan flow control
paragraphsEn: IEC 101/103 require the port and UART settings to match the actual device; COM connection alone does not prove that the RTU can decode the bytes.
paragraphsId: IEC 101/103 memerlukan port serta pengaturan UART sesuai perangkat; COM yang terbuka saja belum membuktikan RTU dapat men-decode byte.

prerequisitesEn: Approved wiring diagram and actual IEC serial interoperability settings.
prerequisitesId: Diagram kabel yang disetujui dan pengaturan interoperability serial IEC yang sebenarnya.
stepsEn: Read the Windows Device Manager COM number and select it under SERIAL CONNECTION; use Refresh if the port list changed.
Set Baudrate and Serial (for example 8E1 only when specified by the device).
Choose Flow control None, RTS/CTS or XON/XOFF according to the installation.
Review output lines RTS and DTR; do not energize an unapproved control line.
Enter the correct Link Address and address/field widths in the interoperability profile.
Confirm physical wiring, grounding and converter signal directions before Connect.
stepsId: Baca nomor COM di Device Manager lalu pilih pada SERIAL CONNECTION; klik Refresh jika daftar port berubah.
Atur Baudrate dan Serial (misalnya 8E1 hanya jika ditentukan perangkat).
Pilih Flow control None, RTS/CTS atau XON/XOFF sesuai instalasi.
Periksa output line RTS dan DTR; jangan mengaktifkan jalur kontrol tanpa izin.
Masukkan Link Address serta panjang field/address sesuai interoperability profile.
Pastikan wiring, ground dan arah sinyal converter sebelum Connect.
workflow.expectedEn: Raw Frames shows valid link frames only when physical and parser settings agree.
workflow.expectedId: Raw Frames menampilkan link frame valid ketika pengaturan fisik dan parser cocok.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: TX/RX LEDs can flash while response remains invalid. Check null modem/pinout, flow control, baud/parity, Link Address and checksum before adjusting random timeouts.
workflow.troubleshootingId: LED TX/RX bisa berkedip sementara respons tetap invalid. Periksa null modem/pinout, flow control, baud/parity, Link Address dan checksum sebelum mengubah timeout secara acak.

sections.headingEn: Set COT, CA and IOA field widths correctly
sections.headingId: Atur panjang field COT, CA dan IOA dengan benar
paragraphsEn: IEC 101/104 decoder meaning depends on agreed COT, Common Address and IOA sizes. IEC 103 has separate fixed protocol-specific field handling and FUN/INF semantics.
paragraphsId: Makna decode IEC 101/104 bergantung panjang field COT, Common Address dan IOA yang disepakati. IEC 103 memakai penanganan field khusus dan semantik FUN/INF.

stepsEn: Read the supplier interoperability sheet and approved SCADA database.
For IEC 101 choose the agreed Link length plus COT size, CA size and IOA size.
For IEC 104 confirm COT size, CA size and IOA size in Setup; read host and port separately.
Compare Common Address and sample IOA with the station/point list.
Inspect Raw Frames after connection; decode that looks scrambled may indicate mismatched widths rather than bad data.
stepsId: Baca interoperability sheet vendor dan database SCADA yang telah disetujui.
Untuk IEC 101 pilih Link length serta COT size, CA size dan IOA size yang disepakati.
Untuk IEC 104 konfirmasikan COT size, CA size dan IOA size pada Setup; host dan port diisi terpisah.
Bandingkan Common Address dan contoh IOA dengan daftar stasiun/point.
Periksa Raw Frames setelah koneksi; decode kacau dapat disebabkan panjang field salah, bukan data rusak.
workflow.expectedEn: Type ID, COT, CA and IOA are decoded consistently with the selected station profile.
workflow.expectedId: Type ID, COT, CA dan IOA terdecode secara konsisten dengan profil stasiun.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Never repair a wrong displayed signal label by silently altering raw frame bytes or fabricating a Common Address.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jangan memperbaiki label sinyal yang salah dengan mengubah byte raw atau mengarang Common Address.

sections.headingEn: Import and verify a project interoperability profile
sections.headingId: Impor dan verifikasi profil interoperabilitas proyek
paragraphsEn: INTEROPERABILITY CONVENTION offers Generic IEC, optional Historical NUC and Project custom JSON. Importing a profile does not silently change field widths or start transmission.
paragraphsId: INTEROPERABILITY CONVENTION menyediakan Generic IEC, Historical NUC opsional dan Project custom JSON. Impor profil tidak diam-diam mengubah panjang field atau memulai transmisi.

stepsEn: Disconnect before changing the profile.
In Setup choose Import profile and select the approved IEC-10x JSON file.
Read the profile preview and confirm the selected Project custom entry.
Compare visible field widths and address values manually with the imported profile and field device.
Use Export profile only to save a known reviewed configuration.
Reconnect only after all settings and station identity have been validated.
stepsId: Disconnect sebelum mengganti profil.
Pada Setup pilih Import profile lalu pilih file JSON IEC-10x yang disetujui.
Baca preview profil dan pastikan Project custom terpilih.
Bandingkan panjang field dan nilai address yang tampil dengan profil impor serta perangkat lapangan.
Gunakan Export profile hanya untuk menyimpan konfigurasi yang telah ditinjau.
Hubungkan kembali setelah semua pengaturan dan identitas stasiun tervalidasi.
workflow.expectedEn: The application validates the imported profile; an invalid file is rejected rather than used as an invisible fallback.
workflow.expectedId: Aplikasi memvalidasi profil impor; file invalid ditolak, bukan diam-diam dipakai sebagai fallback.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If import is rejected, check JSON schema, protocol, supported field widths and size; importing is not a substitute for project sign-off.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika impor ditolak, cek schema JSON, protokol, panjang field yang didukung dan ukuran file; impor bukan pengganti persetujuan proyek.

sections.headingEn: Start, stop and session limit
sections.headingId: Start, stop dan batas waktu sesi
paragraphsEn: The left rail uses one Connect/Disconnect toggle for an active protocol session; Setup also has a Connect action. Session timeout (s) can limit duration, while 0 denotes the open-ended option in the application settings.
paragraphsId: Action rail kiri menggunakan satu toggle Connect/Disconnect untuk sesi protokol aktif; Setup juga memiliki Connect. Session timeout (s) dapat membatasi durasi, sedangkan 0 berarti opsi tanpa batas otomatis dalam pengaturan aplikasi.

stepsEn: Finish Setup and click Connect in Setup or the left rail.
Confirm the caption changes to Disconnect and transport activity is observable.
If you need bounded evidence, set SESSION LIMIT and Response timeout before starting.
Use Disconnect when finished; wait for active transport closure before changing wiring or profiles.
Use Clear only when you want to clear visible session rows; it is not an export operation.
stepsId: Selesaikan Setup dan klik Connect pada Setup atau action rail kiri.
Pastikan caption berubah menjadi Disconnect dan ada aktivitas transport yang teramati.
Jika membutuhkan evidence berbatas waktu, atur SESSION LIMIT dan Response timeout sebelum mulai.
Klik Disconnect setelah selesai; pastikan transport tertutup sebelum mengubah wiring atau profil.
Gunakan Clear hanya ketika ingin membersihkan baris sesi yang terlihat; itu bukan operasi ekspor.
workflow.expectedEn: A bounded session closes cleanly and its evidence can then be selected, reviewed and saved.
workflow.expectedId: Sesi berbatas waktu berhenti dengan baik dan evidence dapat dipilih, diperiksa serta disimpan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If Connect is refused, read the validation message; it may identify a missing COM port, unsupported balanced mode or inconsistent address/profile settings.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika Connect ditolak, baca pesan validasi; mungkin karena COM belum dipilih, balanced mode belum didukung, atau profil/address tidak cocok.

chapters.summaryEn: Learn each IEC 101/104 mapping field, digital and analog scaling, feedback, profile saving, and separate IEC 103 FUN/INF mapping.
chapters.summaryId: Pelajari setiap field IEC 101/104, scaling digital/analog, feedback, penyimpanan profil, dan mapping FUN/INF IEC 103 yang terpisah.

sections.headingEn: Where to open Signal Map and which protocols it supports
sections.headingId: Lokasi Signal Map dan protokol yang didukung
paragraphsEn: Signals on the Main Window left rail opens the IEC 101/104 IOA editor. IEC 103 uses a separate FUN/INF JSON imported in Setup, not this grid. Signal mapping changes names and engineering display, not original wire bytes.
paragraphsId: Tombol Signals pada rail kiri Main Window membuka editor IOA IEC 101/104. IEC 103 memakai JSON FUN/INF terpisah yang diimpor dari Setup, bukan grid ini. Mapping mengubah nama dan tampilan engineering, bukan byte wire asli.

stepsEn: Select IEC 101 or IEC 104 in Setup, then click Signals on the left rail.
While the Signal Map editor is open, press F1 or choose More actions → Signal Map guide (F1) to open this chapter directly without leaving the grid.
Check the editable profile name and loaded filename at the top of Signal Map.
Use More actions → Load profile... to open an approved IEC 101/104 JSON; use Save As for a new project copy.
stepsId: Pilih IEC 101 atau IEC 104 di Setup, lalu klik Signals pada rail kiri.
Saat editor Signal Map terbuka, tekan F1 atau pilih More actions → Signal Map guide (F1) untuk langsung membuka bab ini tanpa meninggalkan grid.
Periksa nama profil yang bisa diedit serta nama file termuat di bagian atas Signal Map.
Gunakan More actions → Load profile... untuk membuka JSON IEC 101/104 yang disetujui; gunakan Save As untuk salinan baru proyek.
workflow.expectedEn: The correct grid appears with Add, Details, Save, More actions and Save & Apply.
workflow.expectedId: Grid yang benar tampil dengan Add, Details, Save, More actions dan Save & Apply.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If IEC 103 displays a notice rather than the grid, that is expected. Do not substitute FUN/INF for IOA.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika IEC 103 menampilkan pemberitahuan alih-alih grid, itu normal. Jangan mengganti IOA dengan FUN/INF.

sections.headingEn: Eight main columns and their exact meanings
sections.headingId: Delapan kolom utama dan makna tepatnya
paragraphsEn: The default columns are CA, IOA, TI, Signal name, Bay, TYPE, Mnemonic and Scaling. CA is the station ASDU common address, IOA is its object address, TI is IEC numeric Type ID; business TYPE (TM/TSD/RCD/RCA) is not an IEC TI.
paragraphsId: Kolom default ialah CA, IOA, TI, Signal name, Bay, TYPE, Mnemonic dan Scaling. CA adalah common address ASDU stasiun, IOA adalah alamat objek, TI adalah angka Type ID IEC; TYPE bisnis (TM/TSD/RCD/RCA) bukan TI IEC.

stepsEn: Read CA/IOA/TI from Raw Frames and the approved RTU I/O list, not from guesses.
Use Signal name for a meaningful label; Bay for the equipment area; TYPE for business class; Mnemonic for abbreviated function.
Use Details or Ctrl+I to open advanced editing; More actions → Show / hide extra table columns reveals Unit, Group, IEC role, Class, COT, feedback and state map.
stepsId: Baca CA/IOA/TI dari Raw Frames dan I/O list RTU yang disetujui, bukan tebakan.
Gunakan Signal name sebagai label; Bay untuk area peralatan; TYPE untuk kategori bisnis; Mnemonic untuk singkatan fungsi.
Gunakan Details atau Ctrl+I untuk edit lanjutan; More actions → Show / hide extra table columns menampilkan Unit, Group, IEC role, Class, COT, feedback dan state map.
workflow.expectedEn: Address identity and descriptive metadata can be reviewed without scrolling through every advanced field.
workflow.expectedId: Identitas alamat dan metadata deskriptif dapat diperiksa tanpa menggulir semua field lanjutan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: CA is not IEC 101 link address; TI=31 is not business TYPE=TSD; verify both separately.
workflow.troubleshootingId: CA bukan link address IEC 101; TI=31 bukan TYPE bisnis TSD; verifikasi keduanya terpisah.

sections.headingEn: Add and fill a new IEC point
sections.headingId: Add dan isi point IEC baru
paragraphsEn: Add creates a placeholder row with generated IOA and defaults such as TI=30, not a discovered device mapping. Sample CA=1 / IOA=101 / TI=31 below is synthetic and for test practice only.
paragraphsId: Add membuat baris placeholder dengan IOA hasil generate dan default seperti TI=30, bukan mapping perangkat yang terdeteksi. Contoh CA=1 / IOA=101 / TI=31 di bawah sintetis dan hanya untuk latihan.
framesEn: LAB EXAMPLE — replace values from the actual RTU
CA  IOA  TI  SIGNAL NAME
1   101  31  TEST FEEDER TSD CB
Bay: FEEDER   TYPE: TSD   Mnemonic: CB
IEC role: M_DP_TB_1   Policy: MonitorOnly
framesId: CONTOH LAB — ganti dengan data RTU sebenarnya
CA  IOA  TI  NAMA SINYAL
1   101  31  TEST FEEDER TSD CB
Bay: FEEDER   TYPE: TSD   Mnemonic: CB
IEC role: M_DP_TB_1   Policy: MonitorOnly

stepsEn: Click Add, select the row, then open Details → Mapping.
Replace Common address (CA), Information object (IOA) and IEC Type ID (TI) with the real station values; for a lab use CA=1, IOA=101, TI=31 only if the demo emits this point.
Enter Signal name and IEC Type / role (TI31 = M_DP_TB_1 for timed double-point), set Command policy MonitorOnly for feedback.
Click Validate signal and compare with original Raw Frames before saving.
stepsId: Klik Add, pilih baris, lalu buka Details → Mapping.
Ganti Common address (CA), Information object (IOA) dan IEC Type ID (TI) dengan nilai stasiun sebenarnya; untuk lab gunakan CA=1, IOA=101, TI=31 hanya jika demo mengirim point tersebut.
Isi Signal name dan IEC Type / role (TI31 = M_DP_TB_1 untuk timed double-point), set Command policy MonitorOnly untuk feedback.
Klik Validate signal lalu cocokkan dengan Raw Frames asli sebelum menyimpan.
workflow.expectedEn: The mapped CA/IOA/TI and name describe one verified information object.
workflow.expectedId: CA/IOA/TI dan nama mapping mendeskripsikan satu information object terverifikasi.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Replace all Add defaults: wrong TI, IOA or station CA can produce misleading names despite a valid connection.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Ganti seluruh default Add: TI, IOA atau CA salah dapat menghasilkan nama menyesatkan walaupun koneksi valid.

sections.headingEn: Name, Bay, business TYPE, Mnemonic and Generate name
sections.headingId: Name, Bay, TYPE bisnis, Mnemonic dan Generate name
paragraphsEn: The naming helper composes Bay + business TYPE + Mnemonic and keeps an existing trailing numeric LAB suffix. It only changes Name after the user explicitly clicks Generate name; browsing never renames rows.
paragraphsId: Pembantu penamaan menyusun Bay + TYPE bisnis + Mnemonic dan mempertahankan suffix angka LAB yang sudah ada. Name hanya berubah setelah pengguna klik Generate name; memilih baris tidak mengganti nama otomatis.

stepsEn: Select a point, open Details → Mapping → Identity & naming.
For a synthetic breaker status enter Bay type=FEEDER, TYPE=TSD, Mnemonic=CB.
Press Generate name; expect FEEDER TSD CB (or FEEDER TSD CB 2 if the existing name ends with 2).
Review Group and Description and confirm the project's approved spelling.
stepsId: Pilih point, buka Details → Mapping → Identity & naming.
Untuk status breaker sintetis isi Bay type=FEEDER, TYPE=TSD, Mnemonic=CB.
Tekan Generate name; hasilnya FEEDER TSD CB (atau FEEDER TSD CB 2 jika nama lama diakhiri 2).
Periksa Group dan Description serta pastikan ejaan sesuai proyek.
workflow.expectedEn: The clear name is searchable and raw CA/IOA/TI remain unchanged.
workflow.expectedId: Nama jelas dapat dicari dan CA/IOA/TI raw tidak berubah.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If Generate name fails, complete all three inputs. TM/TSD/RCD are business categories, never IEC numeric Type IDs.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika Generate name gagal, lengkapi ketiga input. TM/TSD/RCD adalah kategori bisnis, bukan angka IEC Type ID.

sections.headingEn: Search, edit, filter, duplicate and paste safely
sections.headingId: Search, edit, filter, duplicate dan paste dengan aman
paragraphsEn: Signal Map has Ctrl+F search, Bay/Signal type filters, cell editing and advanced columns. View operations do not dirty the profile. Duplicate creates a temporary IOA+1 and copies other fields including Feedback IOA.
paragraphsId: Signal Map menyediakan Ctrl+F search, filter Bay/Signal type, edit sel dan kolom lanjutan. Operasi tampilan tidak mengubah profil. Duplicate membuat IOA+1 sementara dan menyalin field lain termasuk Feedback IOA.

stepsEn: Press Ctrl+F to search IOA/name/Bay/Mnemonic; Enter focuses a match, Esc clears the query.
Filter by Bay or Measured analog / Digital status / Commands; press × to reset filters before deciding a row is missing.
Select a cell, use F2 or Enter to edit, Enter/Tab to commit, Esc to cancel; Ctrl+I toggles Details.
After spreadsheet paste or More actions → Duplicate signal, verify every CA/IOA/TI, feedback and numeric value; Validate entire list.
stepsId: Tekan Ctrl+F untuk mencari IOA/nama/Bay/Mnemonic; Enter fokus hasil, Esc menghapus query.
Filter berdasarkan Bay atau Measured analog / Digital status / Commands; tekan × untuk reset sebelum menyimpulkan baris hilang.
Pilih sel, gunakan F2 atau Enter untuk edit, Enter/Tab untuk commit, Esc untuk batal; Ctrl+I mengatur Details.
Setelah paste spreadsheet atau More actions → Duplicate signal, periksa setiap CA/IOA/TI, feedback dan nilai numerik; Validate entire list.
workflow.expectedEn: Edits mark Unsaved while search and filters do not; no duplicated profile key survives validation.
workflow.expectedId: Edit menandai Unsaved sedangkan search dan filter tidak; key profil duplikat tidak lolos validasi.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: A duplicate may carry an outdated Feedback IOA; numeric search prioritizes an exact IOA match over references to it.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Duplikat dapat membawa Feedback IOA lama; pencarian numerik memprioritaskan kecocokan IOA langsung dibanding referensi ke sana.

sections.headingEn: Digital State map, Class, COT and signal quality
sections.headingId: State map digital, Class, COT dan kualitas sinyal
paragraphsEn: State map pairs exact decoded state keys with labels using key=value; semicolons separate pairs. Class is an IEC101 poll priority hint, COT is Cause of Transmission. Neither changes QDS, timestamps or source bytes.
paragraphsId: State map memasangkan key state hasil decode dengan label menggunakan key=value; pasangan dipisahkan titik koma. Class adalah petunjuk prioritas polling IEC101, COT adalah Cause of Transmission. Keduanya tidak mengubah QDS, timestamp atau byte sumber.

stepsEn: Choose a digital feedback row (for example TI31), set Command policy MonitorOnly, then inspect its raw decoded state.
In Details → Mapping enter a project-confirmed State map; example only: 1=Open; 2=Closed.
Set Class=1 only when IEC101 Class1 event priority is documented; set COT=3 only if spontaneous delivery is expected, otherwise leave unspecified.
Validate signal and inspect original Event and Raw Frame quality/timestamp alongside the mapped label.
stepsId: Pilih baris feedback digital (misalnya TI31), set Command policy MonitorOnly, lalu lihat state raw hasil decode.
Di Details → Mapping isi State map yang terkonfirmasi proyek; contoh saja: 1=Open; 2=Closed.
Set Class=1 hanya jika prioritas event Class1 IEC101 terdokumentasi; set COT=3 hanya jika pelaporan spontaneous diharapkan, jika belum pasti biarkan kosong.
Validate signal lalu periksa quality/timestamp Event dan Raw Frame asli bersama label mapping.
workflow.expectedEn: Readable status labels match observed keys without being confused with physical breaker confirmation.
workflow.expectedId: Label status mudah dibaca dan sesuai key teramati tanpa disamakan dengan konfirmasi breaker fisik.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Malformed key=value pairs fail validation; do not assume decoder keys 1/2 without checking actual data.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Pasangan key=value cacat gagal validasi; jangan mengasumsikan key decoder 1/2 tanpa memeriksa data.

sections.headingEn: Analog Factor: Scale, Offset, Ratio and Unit
sections.headingId: Factor analog: Scale, Offset, Ratio dan Unit
paragraphsEn: Scaling tab is available for measured analog TI. Factor uses Y = Source × (NormalizedFullScale for NVA only) × Scale × RatioPrimary/RatioSecondary + Offset. Unit is a display suffix, not an automatic conversion. TI11 uses signed I16 counts, TI9 decoded normalized fraction, TI13 IEEE float.
paragraphsId: Tab Scaling tersedia untuk TI pengukuran analog. Factor memakai Y = Source × (NormalizedFullScale hanya untuk NVA) × Scale × RatioPrimary/RatioSecondary + Offset. Unit merupakan suffix tampilan, bukan konversi otomatis. TI11 memakai signed I16 counts, TI9 pecahan normalized decoded, TI13 IEEE float.

stepsEn: Select a measured TI, open Details → Scaling and choose Factor.
Use identity defaults Scale=1, Offset=0, Ratio primary=1, Ratio secondary=1, Normalized full-scale=1 until an approved scaling is available.
For a lab TI13 source already sending 12.5 MW, Unit=MW and Factor identity should still show 12.5 MW.
Only enter project-confirmed factors, validate and compare to independent readings; never multiply CT/PT twice.
stepsId: Pilih TI pengukuran, buka Details → Scaling lalu pilih Factor.
Gunakan default identity Scale=1, Offset=0, Ratio primary=1, Ratio secondary=1, Normalized full-scale=1 sampai ada scaling yang disetujui.
Untuk lab TI13 yang sudah mengirim 12.5 MW, Unit=MW dan Factor identity tetap menampilkan 12.5 MW.
Masukkan faktor hanya yang terkonfirmasi proyek, validasi lalu bandingkan dengan pembacaan independen; jangan menggandakan CT/PT.
workflow.expectedEn: Engineering display follows the explicit formula while original raw value/quality remain available.
workflow.expectedId: Tampilan engineering mengikuti rumus eksplisit sementara nilai/quality raw tetap tersedia.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: For TI11 do not guess MVar per count; for TI9 use decoded normalized X, not the original signed integer bytes.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Untuk TI11 jangan menebak MVar per count; untuk TI9 gunakan X normalized hasil decode, bukan byte integer bertanda asli.

sections.headingEn: Analog TwoPoint: X0/X100 mapped to Y0/Y100
paragraphsEn: TwoPoint is an alternative to Factor, never a second multiplier. Y=Y0+(X−X0)×(Y100−Y0)/(X100−X0). Valid only for explicit measured TI with MonitorOnly; all four finite endpoints are required, X0 must differ from X100, and out-of-range sources extrapolate.
paragraphsId: TwoPoint adalah alternatif Factor, bukan pengali kedua. Y=Y0+(X−X0)×(Y100−Y0)/(X100−X0). Hanya valid untuk TI measured eksplisit dengan MonitorOnly; empat endpoint harus finite, X0 berbeda dari X100, dan sumber di luar rentang diekstrapolasi.
framesEn: SYNTHETIC LAB ONLY — TI9 normalized source
Scaling mode: TwoPoint   Unit: %
Decoded X = 0.25  →  display Y = 25 %
framesId: KHUSUS LAB SINTETIS — sumber TI9 normalized
Scaling mode: TwoPoint   Unit: %
Decoded X = 0.25  →  tampilan Y = 25 %

stepsEn: Select an analog measurement and open Details → Scaling; choose Two-point.
Enter X0/X100 as documented decoded-source endpoints; do not confuse TI11 signed counts, TI9 normalized fraction and TI13 float.
Enter Y0/Y100 as corresponding engineering outputs and Unit; lab-only TI9 example X0=0, X100=1, Y0=0, Y100=100, Unit=%.
Check that synthetic input X=0.25 yields Y=25%, then Validate signal and Validate entire list.
stepsId: Pilih pengukuran analog dan buka Details → Scaling; pilih Two-point.
Isi X0/X100 sebagai endpoint sumber decoded terdokumentasi; jangan campur TI11 signed counts, TI9 normalized fraction dan TI13 float.
Isi Y0/Y100 sebagai output engineering terkait dan Unit; contoh TI9 khusus lab X0=0, X100=1, Y0=0, Y100=100, Unit=%.
Periksa input sintetis X=0.25 menghasilkan Y=25%, lalu Validate signal dan Validate entire list.
workflow.expectedEn: TwoPoint applies without compounding Factor; calibration must be checked with at least two approved source/output pairs.
workflow.expectedId: TwoPoint bekerja tanpa menggabung Factor; kalibrasi harus dicek memakai minimal dua pasangan sumber/output yang disetujui.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: TwoPoint is rejected for control TI, missing endpoints or identical X0/X100; CT/PT nominal alone does not establish full scale. For TI9, X100=+1 in the synthetic example is a conceptual upper endpoint; the largest representable NVA fraction is below +1.
workflow.troubleshootingId: TwoPoint ditolak untuk TI kontrol, endpoint kosong atau X0/X100 sama; nominal CT/PT saja tidak menetapkan full scale. Untuk TI9, X100=+1 pada contoh sintetis adalah endpoint atas konseptual; pecahan NVA terbesar yang bisa direpresentasikan kurang dari +1.

sections.headingEn: Command policy and its separate Feedback IOA
sections.headingId: Command policy dan Feedback IOA yang terpisah
paragraphsEn: The command object (for example TI46 Double Command) is distinct from its status feedback (for example TI31 Double-Point). Command policy and Feedback IOA describe this project relationship, not physical interlock permission.
paragraphsId: Objek command (misalnya TI46 Double Command) berbeda dari feedback status (misalnya TI31 Double-Point). Command policy dan Feedback IOA mendeskripsikan relasi proyek ini, bukan izin operasi interlock fisik.

stepsEn: Select a command row and enter its approved CA/IOA/TI, IEC Type/role, and Command policy in Details → Mapping.
Enter Feedback IOA only after verifying that a separate feedback point exists in the project database.
Keep the feedback indication row MonitorOnly; review the command/feedback binding before saving.
In an authorized safe test, correlate request, ACTCON/termination and independent field status in Controls/Raw Frames.
stepsId: Pilih baris command dan isi CA/IOA/TI, IEC Type/role dan Command policy yang disetujui di Details → Mapping.
Isi Feedback IOA hanya setelah memastikan point feedback terpisah terdapat di database proyek.
Biarkan baris indikasi feedback MonitorOnly; periksa keterkaitan command/feedback sebelum menyimpan.
Dalam pengujian aman yang diizinkan, cocokkan request, ACTCON/terminasi serta status lapangan independen pada Controls/Raw Frames.
workflow.expectedEn: Command and feedback are separately mapped and raw evidence can be inspected without confusing ACK with mechanical operation.
workflow.expectedId: Command dan feedback terpetakan secara terpisah dan evidence raw dapat diperiksa tanpa menyamakan ACK dengan operasi mekanis.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Duplicate signal may copy an old Feedback IOA. Never automatically replay a command with uncertain outcome.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Duplicate signal bisa menyalin Feedback IOA lama. Jangan mengulang command otomatis ketika hasilnya tidak pasti.

sections.headingEn: Validate, Save, Save As and Save & Apply
sections.headingId: Validate, Save, Save As dan Save & Apply
paragraphsEn: Save persists the JSON without closing; Save & Apply validates, writes and closes the dialog so Main Window adopts the profile. The IEC101/104 file schema is ariec10x-ioa-profile-v1; new profiles need a chosen file path.
paragraphsId: Save menyimpan JSON tanpa menutup; Save & Apply memvalidasi, menulis dan menutup dialog agar Main Window memakai profil. Schema file IEC101/104 ialah ariec10x-ioa-profile-v1; profil baru membutuhkan path pilihan.

stepsEn: Click Validate signal per changed point, then More actions → Validate entire list to catch duplicates and invalid scaling.
Enter a descriptive profile name; use Save to keep editing, or More actions → Save As new profile... to preserve earlier versions.
After review click Save & Apply and choose a JSON file path if prompted.
Check the profile name/count in Main Window, reopen Signal Map and compare CA/IOA/TI and saved engineering settings.
stepsId: Klik Validate signal pada tiap point berubah, lalu More actions → Validate entire list untuk duplikat dan scaling invalid.
Isi nama profil yang jelas; gunakan Save untuk terus edit, atau More actions → Save As new profile... untuk mempertahankan versi lama.
Setelah review klik Save & Apply dan pilih path file JSON bila diminta.
Periksa nama/jumlah profil di Main Window, buka ulang Signal Map dan cocokkan CA/IOA/TI serta setting engineering tersimpan.
workflow.expectedEn: JSON is saved and the correct profile is applied to the UI; this does not independently certify the RTU list.
workflow.expectedId: JSON disimpan dan profil benar diterapkan ke UI; ini tidak menyertifikasi I/O list RTU secara independen.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Blank names, duplicate identity keys, zero ratio divisor or incomplete TwoPoint are rejected; use a new filename for field revisions.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Nama kosong, key identitas duplikat, pembagi ratio nol atau TwoPoint tak lengkap ditolak; gunakan nama file baru untuk revisi lapangan.

sections.headingEn: Optional Sync 31 I/O, observed-CA alignment and FAT CSV
sections.headingId: Opsional Sync 31 I/O, align CA dan CSV FAT
paragraphsEn: More actions contains a special bundled 31-point SCADA reference, not a universal autodetector. Sync only considers exact CA=105/IOA/TI matches and requires saving a new copy. Align profile to CA is for a verified single-station case. Field FAT CSV starts NOT TESTED.
paragraphsId: More actions memiliki referensi SCADA 31 point khusus, bukan autodetector universal. Sync hanya mempertimbangkan kecocokan CA=105/IOA/TI yang persis dan harus menyimpan salinan baru. Align profile to CA hanya untuk kasus satu stasiun terverifikasi. CSV FAT dimulai NOT TESTED.

stepsEn: Skip Sync 31 I/O unless the project's approved I/O list is really the exact bundled reference.
When relevant, use More actions → Sync 31 I/O reference..., review all proposed metadata/range changes and Save As a distinct JSON.
Only use Align profile to CA ... after proving the observed CA and confirming the profile is single-station; it does not change serial link address.
Choose Export blank Field FAT worksheet... for a CSV based on current edits; verify the real frame/field results before marking any pass.
stepsId: Lewati Sync 31 I/O kecuali I/O list proyek yang disetujui memang sama persis dengan referensi bawaan.
Jika relevan, pilih More actions → Sync 31 I/O reference..., periksa semua perubahan metadata/range yang diusulkan lalu Save As JSON terpisah.
Gunakan Align profile to CA ... hanya setelah CA teramati dibuktikan dan profil satu stasiun dipastikan; ini tidak mengubah serial link address.
Pilih Export blank Field FAT worksheet... untuk CSV berdasarkan edit saat ini; verifikasi hasil frame/field asli sebelum menandai lulus.
workflow.expectedEn: The original map remains preserved; FAT evidence is not labeled passed without testing.
workflow.expectedId: Map asli tetap terjaga; evidence FAT tidak ditandai lulus tanpa pengujian.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Sync is not a calibration certificate or mapping solution for other stations; do not override customer-specific analog ranges.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Sync bukan sertifikat kalibrasi maupun solusi mapping stasiun lain; jangan menimpa range analog khusus pelanggan.

sections.headingEn: IEC 103 uses a different FUN/INF JSON profile
sections.headingId: IEC 103 memakai profil JSON FUN/INF berbeda
paragraphsEn: IEC103 uses schema ariec60870-mapping-profile-v1, with per-signal id, fun, inf, optional type and name/group. The Signal Map grid does not edit this schema. Sample FUN=192/INF=36 is an example profile, not guaranteed vendor truth.
paragraphsId: IEC103 memakai schema ariec60870-mapping-profile-v1, dengan id, fun, inf, type opsional dan name/group per sinyal. Grid Signal Map tidak mengedit schema ini. Contoh FUN=192/INF=36 hanya contoh profil, bukan kebenaran vendor universal.

stepsEn: In IEC103 Setup obtain the project's relay FUN/INF table and open samples/mapping-profiles/example-user-mapping.profile.json as a reference.
Make a user-owned copy; edit profileName/deviceName plus signals[].id, fun, inf, type, name and optional stateMap. FUN and INF must each be 0..255.
Use Setup → mapping Browse to load the IEC103 JSON, then check the displayed loaded profile/count.
Confirm FUN/INF and relay timestamp in actual Raw Frames/Events rather than assuming the sample labels match the IED.
stepsId: Dalam Setup IEC103 ambil tabel FUN/INF relay proyek dan buka samples/mapping-profiles/example-user-mapping.profile.json sebagai referensi.
Buat salinan milik pengguna; edit profileName/deviceName serta signals[].id, fun, inf, type, name dan stateMap opsional. FUN dan INF masing-masing 0..255.
Gunakan Setup → Browse mapping untuk memuat JSON IEC103, lalu cek profil/jumlah yang tampil.
Pastikan FUN/INF dan timestamp relay pada Raw Frames/Events asli, jangan menganggap label sampel cocok dengan IED.
workflow.expectedEn: IEC103 mapped relay names remain tied to original FUN/INF evidence.
workflow.expectedId: Nama mapping relay IEC103 tetap terhubung ke evidence FUN/INF asli.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: A message that Signal List Editor is only for IEC101/104 is expected; never enter FUN/INF as IOA.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Pesan bahwa Signal List Editor hanya untuk IEC101/104 adalah normal; jangan mengisi FUN/INF sebagai IOA.

sections.headingEn: Prove mapping with Raw Frames, Values and Events
sections.headingId: Buktikan mapping dengan Raw Frames, Values dan Events
paragraphsEn: A successful Save or Validate proves internal structure, not the remote RTU or relay mapping. An FAT record must link source bytes to a mapped point, displayed state/engineering value and independent site evidence.
paragraphsId: Save atau Validate sukses hanya membuktikan struktur internal, bukan mapping RTU atau relay remote. Catatan FAT harus menghubungkan byte sumber ke point mapping, state/nilai engineering yang tampil dan evidence site independen.

stepsEn: Load a trusted .ariec capture or connect to an approved endpoint, then select the source telegram in Raw Frames.
Check Type ID, COT, CA/IOA or FUN/INF, value, quality and source time against the I/O list.
Search the signal in Values and Events; inspect original source-frame navigation, label, unit and selected scaling.
Investigate missing/incorrect CA, IOA, TI, raw state keys or guessed scaling before approving FAT; export selected trace and Field FAT CSV.
stepsId: Load capture .ariec tepercaya atau connect ke endpoint yang disetujui, lalu pilih telegram sumber pada Raw Frames.
Periksa Type ID, COT, CA/IOA atau FUN/INF, nilai, quality dan waktu sumber terhadap I/O list.
Cari sinyal pada Values dan Events; periksa navigasi frame sumber asli, label, unit dan scaling terpilih.
Selidiki CA, IOA, TI, key status raw atau scaling tebakan yang hilang/salah sebelum menyetujui FAT; ekspor trace terpilih dan CSV Field FAT.
workflow.expectedEn: Trace source → profile identity → display name/value → independently verified field meaning forms a complete evidence chain.
workflow.expectedId: Sumber trace → identitas profil → nama/nilai tampilan → makna lapangan terverifikasi membentuk rantai evidence lengkap.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: A visible label, passed validator, connected session or ACTCON alone does not demonstrate actual physical state.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Label tampil, validator lulus, sesi connected atau ACTCON saja tidak membuktikan state fisik sebenarnya.

chapters.summaryId: Bentuk link unbalanced yang tepat dan bedakan polling, GI serta evidence event.

sections.headingEn: Prepare the serial IEC 101 connection
paragraphsEn: IEC 101 master uses serial link framing and Class 1/Class 2 polling. This build does not offer active balanced-master polling; the displayed balanced selection is explicitly marked as planned.
paragraphsId: Master IEC 101 menggunakan framing link serial dan polling Class 1/Class 2. Build ini belum menyediakan polling master balanced aktif; opsi balanced ditandai sebagai rencana.

stepsEn: Choose IEC 60870-5-101 - Telecontrol serial in Setup.
Select Real device / server, then COM, Baudrate, serial format and required Flow control.
Set Link Address, Common Address, Link length, COT size, CA size and IOA size from the device interoperability profile.
Use Unbalanced for supported master polling. Review Reset remote link and Reset FCB startup settings according to device policy.
Click Connect and inspect Raw Frames.
stepsId: Pilih IEC 60870-5-101 - Telecontrol serial pada Setup.
Pilih Real device / server, lalu COM, Baudrate, format serial dan Flow control sesuai kebutuhan.
Atur Link Address, Common Address, Link length, COT size, CA size dan IOA size dari interoperability profile perangkat.
Gunakan Unbalanced untuk polling master yang didukung. Tinjau Reset remote link dan Reset FCB sesuai kebijakan perangkat.
Klik Connect lalu periksa Raw Frames.
workflow.expectedEn: Correct link initialization and directionally paired link requests/responses are visible.
workflow.expectedId: Inisialisasi link yang benar dan request/response link berpasangan sesuai arah terlihat.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If link-status replies are missing, verify correct RTU address, serial wiring, output lines, COM occupancy and physical TX/RX capture before interpreting COT.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika respons link-status hilang, verifikasi address RTU, wiring serial, output line, COM yang digunakan serta TX/RX fisik sebelum menafsirkan COT.

sections.headingEn: Understand Class 2 and Class 1 traffic
paragraphsEn: The CLASS POLLING POLICY includes a Class 2 interval and a maximum Class 1 drain. ACD may signal pending high-priority information; DFC concerns link flow control, not the QDS overflow bit.
paragraphsId: CLASS POLLING POLICY mencakup Class 2 interval dan maksimum drain Class 1. ACD dapat menunjukkan data prioritas menunggu; DFC menyangkut flow control link, bukan bit overflow QDS.

stepsEn: Observe Class 2 requests in Raw Frames after startup.
Check their secondary responses: valid data or permitted no-data can both be healthy.
When ACD indicates priority data, look for bounded Class 1 requests and associated responses.
Review Events and the Class counters together, not independently.
When Class 1 never empties, inspect event classification, queue size, poll cadence and response validity.
stepsId: Amati request Class 2 pada Raw Frames setelah startup.
Periksa respons secondary: data valid maupun no-data yang diizinkan dapat sama-sama sehat.
Saat ACD menunjukkan data prioritas, cari request Class 1 terbatas beserta responsnya.
Periksa Events bersama penghitung Class, bukan terpisah.
Saat Class 1 tidak pernah kosong, cek klasifikasi event, ukuran antrian, ritme polling dan validitas respons.
workflow.expectedEn: Master continues normal scans without equating an empty Class 2 queue to a communication failure.
workflow.expectedId: Master melanjutkan scan normal tanpa menyamakan antrian Class 2 kosong dengan kegagalan komunikasi.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: E5 can be ACK or context-permitted no-data depending on the outstanding request; the raw byte itself has no FC, ACD, DFC or link address.
workflow.troubleshootingId: E5 dapat merupakan ACK atau no-data yang diizinkan sesuai request tertunda; byte mentahnya tidak memiliki FC, ACD, DFC maupun link address.

sections.headingEn: Perform and verify GI
paragraphsEn: General Interrogation requests a current application image. Sending GI does not by itself prove that the RTU returned all configured points.
paragraphsId: General Interrogation meminta image aplikasi terkini. Mengirim GI sendiri belum membuktikan RTU mengirim semua point yang dikonfigurasi.

stepsEn: Before Connect, optionally select General interrogation on connect for the initial session.
Alternatively, during a connected IEC 101 session expand COMMAND PANEL and press GI • TI-100.
Open the GI workspace and correlate activation, response ASDUs, source address and completion evidence.
Compare received values against the approved project signal list in Values.
Save relevant Raw Frames and GI case evidence for the FAT record.
stepsId: Sebelum Connect, bila perlu aktifkan General interrogation on connect untuk sesi awal.
Atau saat sesi IEC 101 terhubung buka COMMAND PANEL dan klik GI • TI-100.
Buka workspace GI dan cocokkan aktivasi, ASDU respons, address sumber serta evidence penyelesaian.
Bandingkan Values yang diterima dengan daftar sinyal proyek yang disetujui.
Simpan Raw Frames dan evidence kasus GI yang relevan untuk laporan FAT.
workflow.expectedEn: The GI case shows a traceable request, applicable confirmations, data and completion, or an explicit partial/unknown result.
workflow.expectedId: Kasus GI menampilkan request, konfirmasi yang berlaku, data serta terminasi yang dapat ditelusuri, atau hasil partial/unknown yang jelas.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If fewer points arrive than expected, check configuration group, mapping, bandwidth, queue/backpressure and missing ACTTERM rather than assuming a fixed count mandated by IEC.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika point yang masuk lebih sedikit dari harapan, cek grup konfigurasi, mapping, bandwidth, antrian/backpressure dan ACTTERM yang hilang; IEC tidak menentukan angka point sembarang yang wajib.

sections.headingEn: Diagnose slow-baud or repeated-poll problems
sections.headingId: Diagnosa baud rendah atau polling berulang
paragraphsEn: At 1200 bps or a busy serial RTU, transport bandwidth and an overflowing event queue can delay GI/background traffic. Software traces may not prove electrical inter-frame idle timing.
paragraphsId: Pada 1200 bps atau RTU serial yang sibuk, bandwidth dan antrian event penuh dapat menunda GI/traffic background. Trace software tidak selalu membuktikan idle timing elektrik antarfame.

stepsEn: Record a time-bounded trace that includes requests and both physical directions.
Measure how often Class 2, bounded Class 1 and GI transactions are visible.
Distinguish a valid no-data response from an actual response timeout.
Review max drain, device buffer behavior and possible serial CTS/RTS constraints against profile.
Change only one approved setting at a time, recapture and compare evidence.
stepsId: Rekam trace berbatas waktu yang mencakup request dan kedua arah fisik.
Amati frekuensi transaksi Class 2, drain Class 1 terbatas dan GI.
Bedakan respons no-data valid dari response timeout sebenarnya.
Periksa max drain, perilaku buffer perangkat dan kemungkinan pembatas CTS/RTS sesuai profil.
Ubah hanya satu pengaturan yang disetujui pada satu waktu, capture ulang dan bandingkan evidence.
workflow.expectedEn: The investigation identifies whether failure is physical, link response, application queue or mapping-related.
workflow.expectedId: Investigasi menunjukkan apakah kegagalan berkaitan dengan fisik, respons link, antrian aplikasi atau mapping.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Do not increase retry loops blindly; repeated commands/polls can worsen a saturated 1200-bps circuit.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jangan memperbanyak retry secara membabi buta; command/poll berulang dapat memperparah sirkuit 1200-bps yang jenuh.

sections.headingEn: Connect the relay safely
paragraphsEn: IEC 60870-5-103 - Protection relay serial is a distinct serial protocol mode with relay-oriented event semantics; it is not the IEC 101 CA/IOA model.
paragraphsId: IEC 60870-5-103 - Protection relay serial adalah mode protokol serial tersendiri dengan semantik event relay; bukan model CA/IOA IEC 101.

stepsEn: Choose IEC 60870-5-103 in PROTOCOL PROFILE.
Match COM, baud, serial parity/stop bits, flow control and relay link address.
Review the displayed IEC 103 startup and polling options in Setup.
Choose Real device / server for a physical relay and click Connect.
Check link replies in Raw Frames before judging FUN/INF objects.
stepsId: Pilih IEC 60870-5-103 pada PROTOCOL PROFILE.
Sesuaikan COM, baud, parity/stop bit, flow control serta link address relay.
Periksa opsi startup dan polling IEC 103 yang muncul dalam Setup.
Pilih Real device / server untuk relay fisik dan klik Connect.
Cek respons link pada Raw Frames sebelum menilai objek FUN/INF.
workflow.expectedEn: Valid link and relay data traffic become available to the analyzer.
workflow.expectedId: Traffic link dan data relay valid tersedia untuk dianalisis.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If a link looks active but no event appears, verify the relay event settings and request/response frames rather than interpreting no-data as a fault.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika link aktif tetapi event tidak terlihat, verifikasi pengaturan event relay dan frame request/response; no-data bukan selalu kegagalan.

sections.headingEn: Load signal descriptions for FUN/INF
paragraphsEn: ArSee can use a user-owned mapping profile so decoded numeric relay identifiers are displayed with project-specific signal names; unrecognized FUN/INF must remain identifiable.
paragraphsId: ArSee dapat memakai mapping milik pengguna supaya identitas relay numerik terdecode ditampilkan dengan nama sinyal proyek; FUN/INF yang belum dikenal harus tetap dapat dikenali.

stepsEn: Click Signals on the left rail to open the Signal List editor, or use the mapping profile control in Setup.
Select an approved relay FUN/INF map for the tested IED model.
Verify sample numeric FUN and INF values against the actual relay documentation.
Reopen Values, Events and Raw Frames to compare label, source and raw identity.
Keep the profile local; avoid sharing proprietary customer point maps publicly.
stepsId: Klik Signals pada action rail kiri untuk membuka Signal List editor, atau gunakan pengaturan mapping dalam Setup.
Pilih map FUN/INF relay yang disetujui untuk model IED yang diuji.
Verifikasi contoh angka FUN dan INF dengan dokumentasi relay sebenarnya.
Buka lagi Values, Events dan Raw Frames untuk mencocokkan label, sumber dan identitas mentah.
Simpan profil secara lokal; hindari publikasi mapping point pelanggan.
workflow.expectedEn: Known signals show correct project names without altering recorded raw FUN/INF.
workflow.expectedId: Sinyal yang dikenal tampil dengan nama proyek yang benar tanpa mengubah FUN/INF raw.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Wrong signal name can be a mapping issue even when the FT1.2 link and ASDU are valid.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Nama sinyal salah dapat berasal dari mapping meskipun link FT1.2 dan ASDU valid.

sections.headingEn: Verify protection-event evidence
paragraphsEn: Pickup, trip and reset are protection-function events; they are not automatically the same as breaker auxiliary-contact feedback.
paragraphsId: Pickup, trip dan reset adalah event fungsi proteksi; bukan otomatis sama dengan feedback kontak bantu breaker.

stepsEn: Use an approved relay simulator/test procedure or permitted non-operational test event.
Observe relevant Class polling and response frames.
Inspect Events for relay event meaning and timestamp.
Open its original frame in Raw Frames and verify FUN/INF.
If a gateway is involved, separately verify outgoing IEC 101/104 point mapping and actual breaker feedback.
stepsId: Gunakan simulator relay/prosedur uji yang disetujui atau event test non-operasional yang diizinkan.
Amati polling Class terkait dan frame respons.
Periksa Events untuk arti event relay dan timestamp.
Buka frame asal pada Raw Frames dan verifikasi FUN/INF.
Jika melalui gateway, verifikasi terpisah mapping point IEC 101/104 keluar dan feedback breaker aktual.
workflow.expectedEn: Test report identifies the observed relay function, timestamp and whether physical breaker position was independently proven.
workflow.expectedId: Laporan tes mengidentifikasi fungsi relay yang teramati, timestamp dan apakah posisi breaker fisik terbukti independen.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Do not claim breaker opened solely from a decoded relay trip indication.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jangan menyatakan breaker membuka hanya berdasarkan indikasi trip relay yang berhasil didecode.

sections.headingEn: Configure TCP server access
paragraphsEn: IEC 104 uses a TCP association to the server/outstation. TCP port 2404 is common but the installation may select another approved listener.
paragraphsId: IEC 104 memakai asosiasi TCP menuju server/outstation. Port TCP 2404 umum dipakai tetapi instalasi dapat menentukan listener lain yang disetujui.

stepsEn: Choose IEC 60870-5-104 - Telecontrol TCP/IP in Setup.
Under IEC-104 TCP/IP ACCESS enter Server host / IP and Port.
Review Common Address and supported COT/CA/IOA widths.
Use Real device / server and confirm the intended target is reachable and authorized.
Click Connect; open Raw Frames to observe IEC 104 APCI.
stepsId: Pilih IEC 60870-5-104 - Telecontrol TCP/IP dalam Setup.
Di IEC-104 TCP/IP ACCESS masukkan Server host / IP dan Port.
Periksa Common Address dan panjang COT/CA/IOA yang didukung.
Gunakan Real device / server dan pastikan target bisa diakses serta diizinkan.
Klik Connect; buka Raw Frames untuk mengamati APCI IEC 104.
workflow.expectedEn: TCP and permitted STARTDT exchange can be correlated with the expected server.
workflow.expectedId: TCP dan pertukaran STARTDT yang diizinkan dapat dikorelasikan dengan server target.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If TCP connect fails, check IP, route, listener port and host firewall authorization; do not disable all firewalls as a diagnostic shortcut.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika koneksi TCP gagal, cek IP, route, port listener dan izin firewall; jangan mematikan seluruh firewall sebagai jalan pintas.

sections.headingEn: Read STARTDT, I/S/U frames and sequence
paragraphsEn: An established TCP socket is not yet proof of active application data transfer. IEC 104 APCI has distinct I, S and U frame semantics and sequence state per connection.
paragraphsId: Socket TCP yang terhubung belum membuktikan transfer data aplikasi aktif. APCI IEC 104 memiliki makna I, S dan U berbeda serta state sequence per koneksi.

stepsEn: Inspect STARTDT act and STARTDT con in Raw Frames.
Look for I-frames carrying process or GI ASDUs.
Inspect N(S)/N(R) and S-frame acknowledgments for the same TCP association.
Review TESTFR separately as a liveness exchange, not as a data update.
If the socket reconnects, evaluate new sequence accounting instead of reusing old values.
stepsId: Periksa STARTDT act dan STARTDT con pada Raw Frames.
Cari I-frame yang membawa ASDU proses atau GI.
Periksa N(S)/N(R) dan ACK S-frame pada asosiasi TCP yang sama.
Tinjau TESTFR sebagai pertukaran liveness, bukan update data.
Jika socket reconnect, evaluasi sequence baru, bukan menggunakan nilai lama.
workflow.expectedEn: APCI handshake and data flow can be proven separately from application COT and field status.
workflow.expectedId: Handshake APCI dan alur data dapat dibuktikan terpisah dari COT aplikasi serta status lapangan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Malformed or reserved-control U-frames must not be used to mark the session successfully started.
workflow.troubleshootingId: U-frame yang malformed atau memakai reserved-control salah tidak boleh dipakai sebagai bukti session sukses.

sections.headingEn: Run a real application GI lifecycle
paragraphsEn: GI • TI-100 requests process image values. Its activation, returned data and applicable termination are separate messages; an I-frame ACK alone is not GI completion.
paragraphsId: GI • TI-100 meminta nilai process image. Aktivasi, data balik serta terminasi yang berlaku merupakan pesan terpisah; ACK I-frame bukan penyelesaian GI.

stepsEn: After STARTDT con, open COMMAND PANEL and press GI • TI-100, or use configured GI on connect.
Switch to the GI workspace and select the associated transaction.
Correlate request, positive or negative ACTCON, returned ASDUs and termination evidence.
Check Values for received point data and quality.
Save the relevant Raw Frames and a report with the observed outcome.
stepsId: Sesudah STARTDT con, buka COMMAND PANEL lalu klik GI • TI-100, atau gunakan GI on connect yang telah dikonfigurasi.
Buka workspace GI lalu pilih transaksi terkait.
Cocokkan request, ACTCON positif atau negatif, ASDU data balik serta evidence terminasi.
Periksa Values untuk data point dan quality yang diterima.
Simpan Raw Frames dan laporan dengan hasil aktual yang teramati.
workflow.expectedEn: A completed GI is distinguishable from an accepted-but-incomplete request.
workflow.expectedId: GI yang selesai dapat dibedakan dari request yang diterima tetapi belum lengkap.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If TESTFR succeeds but GI does not, investigate CA, COT, device GI support and application queue, not just network reachability.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika TESTFR sukses tetapi GI gagal, periksa CA, COT, dukungan GI perangkat dan antrian aplikasi, bukan sekadar konektivitas jaringan.

sections.headingEn: Verify spontaneous event reporting
paragraphsEn: An updated Value from GI can mask missing spontaneous reporting. A real spontaneous process change must be supported by an appropriate outgoing ASDU with event COT.
paragraphsId: Value yang berubah akibat GI bisa menyembunyikan masalah pelaporan spontan. Perubahan proses spontan harus didukung ASDU keluar dengan COT event yang sesuai.

stepsEn: Use a simulator or authorized safe point-change procedure.
With STARTDT active, record the point transition and its source time.
Inspect Events for the new information and Raw Frames for COT, CA and IOA.
Compare what the RTU transmitted with what the SCADA/ArSee received.
Treat any event seen only after a new GI as reporting still unproven.
stepsId: Gunakan simulator atau prosedur perubahan point aman yang diizinkan.
Saat STARTDT aktif, rekam perubahan point dan waktu sumber.
Periksa Events untuk informasi baru dan Raw Frames untuk COT, CA dan IOA.
Bandingkan pesan yang dikirim RTU dengan yang diterima SCADA/ArSee.
Jika event baru muncul setelah GI ulang, pelaporan spontan masih belum terbukti.
workflow.expectedEn: Evidence includes actual spontaneous ASDU delivery, not just a refreshed snapshot.
workflow.expectedId: Evidence mencakup pengiriman ASDU spontan sesungguhnya, bukan sekadar snapshot yang disegarkan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If source data changes but no spontaneous TX appears, examine gateway event generation, mapping, active frontend ownership and server event queue.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika data sumber berubah tetapi tidak ada spontaneous TX, periksa pembentukan event gateway, mapping, ownership frontend aktif dan antrian event server.

sections.headingEn: Prepare active and standby links
paragraphsEn: IEC 101 Dual Link is a distinct protocol profile. Standby B is supervised according to its link policy; it does not issue independent Class 1/Class 2 polling or controls while standby.
paragraphsId: IEC 101 Dual Link adalah profil protokol tersendiri. Standby B diawasi sesuai kebijakan link; tidak melakukan polling Class 1/Class 2 atau kontrol independen saat standby.

stepsEn: Choose IEC 60870-5-101 - Dual link redundancy in Setup.
Select primary COM A and the backup COM B, each with valid approved wiring.
Review link address A and Link B addr; heed the different-address advisory if shown.
Review the common serial framing and link fields against the approved redundant RTU configuration.
Connect, then open the Redundancy workspace to review link status.
stepsId: Pilih IEC 60870-5-101 - Dual link redundancy pada Setup.
Pilih COM primary A dan COM backup B, masing-masing dengan wiring yang disetujui.
Periksa link address A serta Link B addr; ikuti advisory bila address berbeda.
Bandingkan framing serial dan field link dengan konfigurasi redundant RTU yang disetujui.
Connect, lalu buka workspace Redundancy untuk memeriksa status link.
workflow.expectedEn: One application-active link carries normal polling while standby is supervised; both physical links remain identifiable in evidence.
workflow.expectedId: Satu link aplikasi aktif membawa polling normal sementara standby diawasi; kedua link fisik tetap dapat dibedakan dalam evidence.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If B does not show normal Class polling while standby, that is expected for this selected topology; do not call it a failure.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika B tidak menampilkan Class polling saat standby, itu normal untuk topologi ini; jangan dinyatakan gagal.

sections.headingEn: Review standby health before switching
paragraphsEn: A second connected COM is not proof that standby can take over. A successful manual switch request may be declined if the standby is unhealthy.
paragraphsId: COM kedua yang terhubung bukan bukti standby siap mengambil alih. Request manual switch dapat ditolak jika standby tidak sehat.

stepsEn: Observe the Redundancy workspace's link health and event timeline.
Verify address and independent status response on B.
Confirm which link currently owns the master polling and command authority.
Record a baseline of GI/Values and A/B status before performing an approved test.
Keep the original link available for controlled rollback.
stepsId: Amati kesehatan link dan timeline peristiwa pada workspace Redundancy.
Pastikan address dan respons status independen pada B.
Pastikan link mana yang memiliki kewenangan master polling serta command.
Rekam baseline GI/Values dan status A/B sebelum tes yang disetujui.
Pertahankan link awal agar rollback terkendali tersedia.
workflow.expectedEn: Status, owner and evidence timeline show which link is safe for promotion.
workflow.expectedId: Status, owner dan timeline evidence menunjukkan link mana yang aman dipromosikan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If standby is unavailable, investigate B COM, framing, link address, wiring and RTU channel health before forcing switch.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika standby tidak tersedia, cek COM B, framing, link address, wiring dan kesehatan channel RTU sebelum memaksakan switch.

sections.headingEn: Request and verify a manual switchover
paragraphsEn: The Redundancy workspace has a manual switchover action that queues takeover only when the standby is healthy. GI after switching follows the selected project policy, not a universal requirement.
paragraphsId: Workspace Redundancy memiliki aksi switchover manual yang mengantrikan takeover hanya bila standby sehat. GI setelah switch mengikuti kebijakan proyek, bukan kewajiban universal.

stepsEn: Confirm the test is authorized and standby status is healthy.
Use the manual switchover control in the Redundancy workspace.
Track the controller timeline for promotion or refusal.
Check new link initialization, request/response sequence and current active ownership.
Run a GI on the active link only if required by project test procedure; verify data and event continuity.
Save evidence of last A frame and first valid B frame where capture coverage permits.
stepsId: Pastikan tes diizinkan dan status standby sehat.
Gunakan kontrol manual switchover pada workspace Redundancy.
Pantau timeline controller untuk promosi atau penolakan.
Periksa inisialisasi link baru, urutan request/response dan owner aktif.
Jalankan GI pada link aktif hanya jika diwajibkan prosedur tes proyek; verifikasi data dan kontinuitas event.
Simpan evidence frame terakhir A dan frame valid pertama B jika cakupan capture memungkinkan.
workflow.expectedEn: Promotion and its post-switch communication are proven by trace, not just a colored status tile.
workflow.expectedId: Promosi dan komunikasi pasca-switch dibuktikan melalui trace, bukan hanya tile status berwarna.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If a command was in flight at failure, mark execution unknown and read actual field status; never blindly retransmit a physical command.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika command sedang berjalan saat gangguan, tandai eksekusi unknown dan baca status lapangan aktual; jangan mengirim ulang kontrol fisik tanpa verifikasi.

sections.headingEn: Understand physical RX-only safety
paragraphsEn: Physical RX-only uses receive-only taps on transmitter directions. The software does not send protocol commands in this mode, but opening serial hardware can still affect modem lines without physical isolation.
paragraphsId: Physical RX-only menggunakan tap receiver-only pada arah transmitter. Software tidak mengirim command protokol pada mode ini, tetapi membuka hardware serial tetap bisa memengaruhi jalur modem tanpa isolasi fisik.

stepsEn: Use approved isolated/high-impedance serial taps; never connect a monitor TX, RTS or DTR directly to production controls.
For one full-duplex link, prepare two separate COM receive inputs: SCADA TX and RTU TX.
For redundant A/B, select Also monitor redundant Link B (4 RX ports) and prepare four independent receiver inputs.
Match UART framing and decoder Link address/COT/CA/IOA widths to the actual field setup.
Choose IEC 60870-5-101 - Passive Monitor and CAPTURE SOURCE Physical RX-only.
stepsId: Gunakan tap serial isolated/high-impedance yang disetujui; jangan menghubungkan TX, RTS atau DTR monitor langsung ke kontrol produksi.
Untuk satu link full-duplex, siapkan dua COM input receive terpisah: SCADA TX dan RTU TX.
Untuk A/B redundant, aktifkan Also monitor redundant Link B (4 RX ports) dan siapkan empat receiver independen.
Sesuaikan framing UART dan panjang Link address/COT/CA/IOA decoder dengan setup lapangan.
Pilih IEC 60870-5-101 - Passive Monitor dan CAPTURE SOURCE Physical RX-only.
workflow.expectedEn: Both observed directions are distinguishable; no extra Class 1/Class 2 requests originate from the monitor.
workflow.expectedId: Kedua arah yang diamati dapat dibedakan; monitor tidak menghasilkan request Class 1/Class 2 tambahan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: A two-COM tap proves one duplex circuit only; it cannot infer traffic on unobserved Link B. Electrical safety depends on wiring, not the software checkbox.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Tap dua COM hanya membuktikan satu sirkuit duplex; tidak dapat menyimpulkan traffic Link B yang tidak diamati. Keselamatan elektrik bergantung wiring, bukan checkbox.

sections.headingEn: Start live monitoring without recording files
sections.headingId: Mulai monitoring live tanpa merekam file
paragraphsEn: The physical monitor's default optional full-session recording is OFF. Starting a monitor shows live bytes/frames but does not automatically create a raw journal.
paragraphsId: Default optional full-session recording pada physical monitor adalah OFF. Start Monitor menampilkan byte/frame langsung tetapi tidak otomatis membuat raw journal.

stepsEn: In Setup choose both receive COM ports and verify their source-direction labels.
Leave Record entire raw session to disk unchecked if you only need live observation.
Click Start Monitor on the action rail.
Read source byte counters and FT1.2 valid frame count; then inspect Raw Frames, Values and Events.
Select significant frames and use Save Cap if you need a portable evidence subset.
Click Stop Monitor when finished.
stepsId: Pada Setup pilih kedua COM receive dan periksa label arah sumber.
Biarkan Record entire raw session to disk tidak dicentang jika hanya perlu observasi langsung.
Klik Start Monitor pada action rail.
Baca penghitung byte sumber dan jumlah frame FT1.2 valid; lalu lihat Raw Frames, Values dan Events.
Pilih frame penting dan gunakan Save Cap jika memerlukan subset evidence portable.
Klik Stop Monitor saat selesai.
workflow.expectedEn: You can distinguish bytes received from successfully framed IEC telegrams and save only the evidence needed.
workflow.expectedId: Anda dapat membedakan byte yang diterima dari telegram IEC valid, lalu menyimpan evidence seperlunya.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Zero RX counters call for COM/physical direction checks; nonzero RX but zero FT1.2 frames suggests framing/baud/parity/decoder problems.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Penghitung RX nol memerlukan cek COM/arah fisik; RX tidak nol tetapi FT1.2 nol mengarah pada masalah framing/baud/parity/decoder.

sections.headingEn: Enable full raw-session journal when required
sections.headingId: Aktifkan jurnal raw satu sesi bila diperlukan
paragraphsEn: For a complete evidentiary journal, enable the recording checkbox before starting. Its output path is used only when the option is enabled.
paragraphsId: Untuk jurnal evidence lengkap, aktifkan checkbox perekaman sebelum Start. Path output hanya dipakai saat opsi itu aktif.

stepsEn: Stop the current monitor session before changing recording scope.
Check Record entire raw session to disk in Setup.
Select a writable output folder via Browse.
Verify capture source labels and Link A/B receivers, then Start Monitor.
After the intended observation interval, click Stop Monitor and allow journal finalization.
Preserve manifest.json and all related binary streams together.
stepsId: Stop sesi monitor sebelum mengubah cakupan perekaman.
Centang Record entire raw session to disk pada Setup.
Pilih folder output yang dapat ditulis melalui Browse.
Pastikan label sumber capture dan receiver Link A/B, lalu Start Monitor.
Setelah interval observasi selesai, klik Stop Monitor dan izinkan finalisasi jurnal.
Simpan manifest.json bersama seluruh stream binernya.
workflow.expectedEn: An optional full-session journal can be verified and revisited without treating its content as automatically protocol-correct.
workflow.expectedId: Jurnal full-session opsional dapat diverifikasi dan dibuka kembali tanpa menganggap isinya otomatis benar secara protokol.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If recording is OFF, absence of a journal is expected. A capture with missing manifest/stream or failed integrity check should not be used as conclusive evidence.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika recording OFF, tidak adanya jurnal adalah normal. Capture tanpa manifest/stream lengkap atau gagal verifikasi integritas tidak boleh dipakai sebagai evidence pasti.

sections.headingEn: Virtual Inline is not physically RX-only
paragraphsEn: CAPTURE SOURCE also offers Virtual Inline, which actively forwards between two COM endpoints while observing IEC 101 traffic. It is fundamentally different from physical receiver-only tapping.
paragraphsId: CAPTURE SOURCE juga menawarkan Virtual Inline yang meneruskan traffic secara aktif antara dua endpoint COM sekaligus mengamati IEC 101. Ini berbeda secara mendasar dari tap receiver-only fisik.

stepsEn: Use Virtual Inline only on a planned virtual serial bench or explicitly approved inline setup.
Identify which two COM endpoints belong to the master-side and slave-side virtual pair.
Select CAPTURE SOURCE Virtual Inline and configure its ports.
Check that starting changes the action caption to Start Relay/Stop Relay.
Verify both application endpoints communicate normally and stop the relay before reconfiguring.
stepsId: Gunakan Virtual Inline hanya di bench virtual serial atau instalasi inline yang diizinkan eksplisit.
Identifikasi dua endpoint COM sisi master dan sisi slave dari pasangan virtual.
Pilih CAPTURE SOURCE Virtual Inline dan konfigurasi portnya.
Periksa action caption berubah menjadi Start Relay/Stop Relay.
Pastikan kedua endpoint aplikasi berkomunikasi normal dan hentikan relay sebelum reconfig.
workflow.expectedEn: The virtual bridge forwards IEC messages between the intended endpoints and exposes decoded evidence.
workflow.expectedId: Bridge virtual meneruskan pesan IEC antara endpoint yang dimaksud dan menampilkan evidence decoded.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Do not assume Virtual Inline is non-intrusive like a high-impedance passive tap or use it as a production safety bypass.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jangan menganggap Virtual Inline non-intrusive seperti tap pasif high-impedance atau memakainya untuk melewati prosedur keselamatan produksi.
