sections.headingEn: Raw Frames: locate and decode one telegram
sections.headingId: Raw Frames: temukan dan decode satu telegram
paragraphsEn: Raw Frames (also called Frame Trace in the Help Center) exposes recorded wire evidence, direction, decoded protocol fields and selected-frame details.
paragraphsId: Raw Frames (disebut Frame Trace dalam Help Center) menampilkan evidence wire, arah, field protokol terdecode dan detail frame terpilih.

stepsEn: Open Raw Frames from the central workspace navigation.
Look at TX/RX direction, sequence/order, link/APCI validity and the row summary.
Select one frame to inspect its raw HEX and protocol map/detail beside or below the row list.
Read Type ID/COT/CA/IOA or IEC 103 FUN/INF, and check ACD/DFC or APCI sequence where relevant.
Use selected-row copy/export tools to preserve the actual bytes and meaning.
stepsId: Buka Raw Frames pada navigasi workspace tengah.
Lihat arah TX/RX, sequence/order, validitas link/APCI dan ringkasan baris.
Pilih satu frame untuk melihat HEX raw dan protocol map/detail di samping atau bawah daftar.
Baca Type ID/COT/CA/IOA atau FUN/INF IEC 103, lalu ACD/DFC atau sequence APCI bila relevan.
Gunakan copy/export baris terpilih untuk mempertahankan byte dan makna sebenarnya.
workflow.expectedEn: An explanation is grounded in a specific raw frame rather than inferred from a value display alone.
workflow.expectedId: Penjelasan didasarkan pada satu frame raw tertentu, bukan ditebak dari value display saja.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Incorrect decoding may be a wrong interoperability field width, incomplete capture or invalid frame; avoid assigning names before resolving those layers.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Decode keliru dapat terjadi karena panjang field salah, capture tidak lengkap atau frame invalid; hindari memberi nama sinyal sebelum layer itu jelas.

sections.headingEn: Filter or search recent and archived traces
sections.headingId: Filter atau cari trace terbaru dan arsip
paragraphsEn: The trace workspace supports search in visible rows and a separate Find in recorded archive route for captures with more data than the preview window.
paragraphsId: Workspace trace mendukung pencarian pada baris yang terlihat dan jalur Find in recorded archive terpisah untuk capture lebih besar dari preview.

stepsEn: Enter a relevant query in the Raw Frames search field.
Review matching rows and select an item to inspect its decoded details.
For a loaded .ariec capture, choose Find in recorded archive when the target is not in the current preview.
Use previous/next archive search results and cancel an unneeded long query.
Clear the filter before drawing conclusions about absence of traffic.
stepsId: Masukkan kata pencarian pada field search Raw Frames.
Periksa baris yang cocok lalu pilih item untuk melihat detail decode.
Untuk capture .ariec yang dimuat, gunakan Find in recorded archive jika target tidak ada di preview.
Gunakan previous/next hasil pencarian arsip dan cancel jika pencarian tidak diperlukan.
Bersihkan filter sebelum menyimpulkan traffic tidak ada.
workflow.expectedEn: Evidence can be found beyond the bounded live/preview list without assuming only the first visible rows exist.
workflow.expectedId: Evidence dapat ditemukan di luar daftar live/preview terbatas tanpa menganggap hanya baris yang terlihat yang tersedia.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: A zero-result filtered view does not prove the remote device never transmitted the event; expand the search/capture scope.
workflow.troubleshootingId: View hasil filter kosong tidak membuktikan perangkat remote tidak pernah mengirim event; perluas pencarian/cakupan capture.

sections.headingEn: Values: current point image and quality
sections.headingId: Values: image point terkini dan quality
paragraphsEn: Values shows the most recently decoded value per supported point. It is an interpretation projection, not an independent field sensor.
paragraphsId: Values menampilkan nilai terdecode terbaru untuk point yang didukung. Ini proyeksi interpretasi, bukan sensor lapangan independen.

stepsEn: Open Values and search by signal name, CA, IOA, FUN/INF or source as applicable.
Inspect numeric/digital meaning together with quality and time.
Use Open original source frame when the row offers it.
Compare the displayed signal name with the approved Signal List.
If data appear only after GI, separately investigate whether spontaneous events are configured and sent.
stepsId: Buka Values lalu cari nama sinyal, CA, IOA, FUN/INF atau sumber sesuai yang tersedia.
Periksa makna analog/digital bersama quality dan waktu.
Gunakan Open original source frame bila tersedia pada baris.
Bandingkan nama sinyal dengan Signal List yang disetujui.
Jika data hanya muncul setelah GI, periksa secara terpisah konfigurasi dan pengiriman event spontan.
workflow.expectedEn: Displayed value can be traced back to an actual decoded source frame and project mapping.
workflow.expectedId: Value yang tampil dapat ditelusuri ke frame sumber terdecode serta mapping proyek.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: A named point with an invalid quality or wrong CA is not automatically a valid field condition.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Point bernama dengan quality invalid atau CA salah tidak otomatis menunjukkan kondisi lapangan valid.

sections.headingEn: Events: inspect changes and history
paragraphsEn: Events offers event history with search, source-frame navigation and CSV export. A filtered or paged view is not the same as the full indexed history.
paragraphsId: Events menyediakan riwayat event dengan search, navigasi frame sumber dan ekspor CSV. View terfilter atau berpaginasi bukan seluruh riwayat terindeks.

stepsEn: Open Events and search for a changed signal, COT, source or IOA.
Inspect time, semantic value, quality and original source.
Use Open original frame to correlate the event with Raw Frames.
Use pagination or All indexed events controls for deeper history.
Use Export CSV and verify the intended scope before sharing.
stepsId: Buka Events dan cari sinyal berubah, COT, sumber atau IOA.
Periksa waktu, nilai semantik, quality dan sumber asal.
Klik Open original frame untuk mencocokkan event ke Raw Frames.
Gunakan pagination atau All indexed events untuk riwayat lebih dalam.
Gunakan Export CSV lalu verifikasi cakupan sebelum berbagi.
workflow.expectedEn: An event can be traced to its actual decoded frame, and exported rows match the chosen scope.
workflow.expectedId: Event dapat ditelusuri ke frame decoded asli, dan baris ekspor sesuai cakupan yang dipilih.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: When an event is absent, check active filters and capture interval before declaring a missing RTU report.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Saat event tidak terlihat, cek filter aktif dan interval capture sebelum menyatakan RTU gagal melapor.

sections.headingEn: Smart Findings, Controls and GI case views
sections.headingId: Smart Findings, Controls dan view kasus GI
paragraphsEn: Smart Findings proposes diagnostic explanations; Controls and GI views gather transaction-oriented evidence. They cannot replace the raw frames from which conclusions are derived.
paragraphsId: Smart Findings mengusulkan diagnosis; view Controls dan GI mengumpulkan evidence per transaksi. Keduanya tidak menggantikan frame raw yang menjadi dasar kesimpulan.

stepsEn: Open Smart Findings and inspect the proposed cause, evidence and recommended check.
Follow the cited frame or signal rather than applying every suggestion blindly.
Open Controls to inspect command lifecycle evidence when present.
Open GI to inspect an interrogation request/response sequence.
Export or retain the relevant raw evidence for FAT/SAT review.
stepsId: Buka Smart Findings dan periksa dugaan penyebab, evidence serta pemeriksaan yang disarankan.
Ikuti frame/sinyal yang dirujuk, jangan langsung menerapkan semua saran.
Buka Controls untuk memeriksa lifecycle command bila ada.
Buka GI untuk memeriksa urutan request/response interrogation.
Ekspor atau simpan evidence raw yang relevan untuk FAT/SAT.
workflow.expectedEn: The user can separate observed protocol facts from automated diagnostic suggestions.
workflow.expectedId: Pengguna dapat memisahkan fakta protokol teramati dari saran diagnosis otomatis.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Treat a suggested correction as a hypothesis until link framing, address, COT and raw capture prove it.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Anggap saran koreksi sebagai hipotesis sampai framing link, address, COT dan capture raw membuktikannya.

chapters.summaryEn: Use read-only operations first and handle potentially physical controls only under an approved test procedure.
chapters.summaryId: Dahulukan operasi read-only dan gunakan kontrol fisik hanya berdasarkan prosedur uji yang disetujui.
chapters.searchText: Command Panel, GI and controls Command Panel, GI dan kontrol Use read-only operations first and handle potentially physical controls only under an approved test procedure. Dahulukan operasi read-only dan gunakan kontrol fisik hanya berdasarkan prosedur uji yang disetujui. Open the right-side Command Panel Buka Command Panel sisi kanan Use Read IOA and GI before control tests Gunakan Read IOA dan GI sebelum uji kontrol Choose command type and operation mode Pilih jenis command dan mode operasi Read the Select/Operate lifecycle Baca lifecycle Select/Operate

sections.headingEn: Open the right-side Command Panel
paragraphsEn: The right dock is collapsible, and IEC 103 is not an active IEC 101/104 command-ASDU mode in this build.
paragraphsId: Dock kanan dapat dilipat, dan IEC 103 bukan mode command-ASDU aktif IEC 101/104 pada build ini.

stepsEn: Connect an IEC 101 or IEC 104 session with the intended authority.
Click the slim COMMAND PANEL header or chevron on the right to expand.
Review the quick actions GI • TI-100, Timesync • TI-103 and Read IOA • TI-102.
Keep the panel collapsed when you only need passive inspection.
Verify session status before any action that sends protocol traffic.
stepsId: Hubungkan sesi IEC 101 atau IEC 104 dengan kewenangan yang tepat.
Klik header atau chevron COMMAND PANEL ramping di kanan untuk membuka.
Periksa quick action GI • TI-100, Timesync • TI-103 dan Read IOA • TI-102.
Biarkan panel tertutup saat hanya perlu inspeksi pasif.
Pastikan status sesi sebelum menjalankan aksi yang mengirim traffic protokol.
workflow.expectedEn: The panel displays the correct command controls without reducing the center article/trace view unnecessarily.
workflow.expectedId: Panel menampilkan kontrol command yang relevan tanpa mengurangi ruang trace tengah jika tidak diperlukan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If IEC 103 is selected, do not attempt unsupported IEC 101/104 control ASDUs from the dock.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika IEC 103 terpilih, jangan mencoba ASDU kontrol IEC 101/104 yang tidak didukung melalui dock.

sections.headingEn: Use Read IOA and GI before control tests
sections.headingId: Gunakan Read IOA dan GI sebelum uji kontrol
paragraphsEn: Read IOA and GI request application data; positive communication acknowledgement alone is not proof of a fresh data value.
paragraphsId: Read IOA dan GI meminta data aplikasi; ACK komunikasi positif belum membuktikan adanya nilai data terbaru.

stepsEn: For a single-point read enter target Common Address (CA) and IOA.
Click Read IOA • TI-102 while connected and authorized.
Trace the request and its corresponding response in Raw Frames.
For a wider current image use GI • TI-100 and inspect GI cases.
Compare Values and quality with expected station mapping.
stepsId: Untuk baca satu point masukkan Common Address (CA) dan IOA.
Klik Read IOA • TI-102 saat terhubung dan berwenang.
Lacak request serta responsnya pada Raw Frames.
Untuk image lebih luas gunakan GI • TI-100 lalu periksa kasus GI.
Bandingkan Values dan quality dengan mapping stasiun.
workflow.expectedEn: Each read/interrogation request can be distinguished from the resulting data and any negative confirmation.
workflow.expectedId: Setiap read/interrogation request dapat dibedakan dari data hasil dan negative confirmation.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If a read request is rejected or no data appears, verify address, support, station profile and status before sending repeated requests.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika read ditolak atau tanpa data, verifikasi address, dukungan, profil stasiun dan status sebelum request berulang.

sections.headingEn: Choose command type and operation mode
sections.headingId: Pilih jenis command dan mode operasi
paragraphsEn: The dock offers TI 45 Single Command, TI 46 Double Command, TI 47 Regulating, and TI 48 normalized setpoint; Qualifier / operation selects Select Before Operate or Direct Operate.
paragraphsId: Dock menyediakan TI 45 Single Command, TI 46 Double Command, TI 47 Regulating dan TI 48 setpoint normalized; Qualifier / operation memilih Select Before Operate atau Direct Operate.

prerequisitesEn: Approved test point, authorization and device command interoperability sheet.
prerequisitesId: Test point yang disetujui, otorisasi dan interoperability sheet command perangkat.
stepsEn: Select the approved signal in Target or enter CA and IOA explicitly.
Choose the correct Command type and check the target/feedback preview.
Select Select Before Operate (SBO) only if supported by the device profile; otherwise follow the approved direct-operate procedure.
Review QOC QU pulse or QOS QL setpoint qualifier and numeric setpoint where applicable.
Inspect the exact action buttons that update with the selected command and mode.
Do not transmit until an authorized tester has checked target, expected direction, interlock and impact.
stepsId: Pilih sinyal yang disetujui di Target atau isi CA dan IOA secara eksplisit.
Pilih Command type yang benar dan periksa preview target/feedback.
Pilih Select Before Operate (SBO) hanya jika profil perangkat mendukung; jika tidak ikuti prosedur Direct Operate yang disetujui.
Periksa qualifier QOC QU pulse atau QOS QL setpoint serta angka setpoint jika relevan.
Periksa tombol aksi yang berubah sesuai tipe command dan mode.
Jangan kirim sebelum penguji berwenang memeriksa target, arah yang diinginkan, interlock dan dampak.
workflow.expectedEn: The preview and action layout match the intended protocol command; an unsupported or conflicting target is not silently operated.
workflow.expectedId: Preview dan tombol aksi cocok dengan perintah protokol yang dimaksud; target yang tidak didukung atau konflik tidak diam-diam dioperasikan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Do not assume the preselected command type, qualifier or point address is safe for a real breaker; always review them.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jangan menganggap tipe command, qualifier atau point address yang terpilih awal aman untuk breaker; selalu tinjau.
workflow.safetyEn: Never exercise live switchgear solely to verify the Help Center instructions.
workflow.safetyId: Jangan mengoperasikan switchgear hidup hanya untuk memverifikasi instruksi Help Center.

sections.headingEn: Read the Select/Operate lifecycle
paragraphsEn: The dock has Select Open/Close and Operate Open/Close actions appropriate to the chosen mode. For Direct Operate, a stale SELECT input is rejected by application logic.
paragraphsId: Dock memiliki aksi Select Open/Close dan Operate Open/Close sesuai mode. Pada Direct Operate, input SELECT yang stale ditolak oleh logika aplikasi.

stepsEn: In an authorized safe test choose the intended CA/IOA and supported SBO mode.
Issue Select for the target state, then inspect confirmation in Controls and Raw Frames.
If select was accepted and authority remains valid, issue the matching Operate action.
Observe application ACTCON/ACTTERM when supported, and separately inspect actual process-state feedback.
If any transaction times out or a failover intervenes, mark outcome unknown until verified from the source.
stepsId: Pada tes aman yang diizinkan pilih CA/IOA dan mode SBO yang didukung.
Kirim Select untuk state tujuan, lalu periksa konfirmasi pada Controls dan Raw Frames.
Jika select diterima dan kewenangan masih valid, kirim Operate yang sesuai.
Amati ACTCON/ACTTERM aplikasi bila didukung, dan periksa feedback state proses terpisah.
Jika transaksi timeout atau diselingi failover, tandai hasil unknown sampai terverifikasi dari sumber.
workflow.expectedEn: Control case evidence identifies request, confirmation and independently observed final state.
workflow.expectedId: Evidence kasus kontrol mengidentifikasi request, confirmation dan final state yang teramati secara independen.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Transport ACK, positive ACTCON or ACTTERM alone does not guarantee mechanical breaker movement; do not automatically repeat uncertain physical commands.
workflow.troubleshootingId: ACK transport, ACTCON positif atau ACTTERM saja tidak menjamin breaker bergerak; jangan otomatis mengulang command fisik yang hasilnya tidak pasti.

chapters.summaryEn: Preserve selected raw evidence, reopen trustworthy archives and export controlled FAT/SAT reports.
chapters.summaryId: Simpan evidence raw terpilih, buka arsip tepercaya dan ekspor laporan FAT/SAT terkendali.
chapters.searchText: Save captures, export and report Simpan capture, ekspor dan laporan Preserve selected raw evidence, reopen trustworthy archives and export controlled FAT/SAT reports. Simpan evidence raw terpilih, buka arsip tepercaya dan ekspor laporan FAT/SAT terkendali. Save selected evidence as .ariec Simpan evidence terpilih sebagai .ariec Open a capture and validate its scope Buka capture dan validasi cakupannya Export trace text and event CSV Ekspor teks trace dan CSV event Preview and export a PDF report Preview dan ekspor laporan PDF Protect field and customer information Lindungi informasi lapangan dan pelanggan

sections.headingEn: Save selected evidence as .ariec
paragraphsEn: Save Cap exports selected Raw Frames or Evidence Ledger rows as a portable .ariec archive. It is not a blind full-session recording.
paragraphsId: Save Cap mengekspor baris Raw Frames atau Evidence Ledger yang dipilih sebagai arsip portable .ariec. Ini bukan perekaman otomatis seluruh sesi.

stepsEn: In Raw Frames or Evidence Ledger select one or several relevant rows.
Click Save Cap in the left rail or the matching contextual action.
Choose a filename and a destination for the .ariec archive.
Check the confirmation for selected source and row count.
Keep the file with the associated FAT note and approved project profile.
stepsId: Di Raw Frames atau Evidence Ledger pilih satu atau beberapa baris yang relevan.
Klik Save Cap di action rail kiri atau aksi kontekstual terkait.
Pilih nama file dan lokasi arsip .ariec.
Periksa konfirmasi sumber dan jumlah baris terpilih.
Simpan file bersama catatan FAT dan profil proyek yang disetujui.
workflow.expectedEn: An ARIEC capture is written from the selected evidence rows and can later be reopened for offline analysis.
workflow.expectedId: Capture ARIEC ditulis dari baris evidence yang dipilih dan dapat dibuka kembali untuk analisis offline.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: If nothing is selected the application asks you to select rows; do not assume Save Cap silently included every event.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jika tidak ada baris terpilih aplikasi meminta seleksi; jangan mengira Save Cap diam-diam memasukkan semua event.

sections.headingEn: Open a capture and validate its scope
paragraphsEn: Open Cap accepts .ariec/.zip evidence and manifest.json from a full passive journal. Imported preview rows can be bounded, while archived search can examine the broader stored source.
paragraphsId: Open Cap menerima evidence .ariec/.zip dan manifest.json dari jurnal pasif lengkap. Preview impor dapat dibatasi, sementara pencarian arsip dapat memeriksa sumber yang lebih luas.

stepsEn: Click Open Cap in the action rail.
Select an .ariec or .zip capture, or manifest.json when reopening a complete passive recording.
Allow the application to validate the archive and restore its evidence projection.
Open Raw Frames and inspect protocol/source metadata before trusting displayed labels.
Use Find in recorded archive when the needed frame is outside the visible preview.
stepsId: Klik Open Cap di action rail.
Pilih capture .ariec atau .zip, atau manifest.json saat membuka jurnal pasif lengkap.
Izinkan aplikasi memvalidasi arsip dan memulihkan proyeksi evidence.
Buka Raw Frames dan periksa metadata protokol/sumber sebelum mempercayai label.
Gunakan Find in recorded archive jika frame yang diperlukan di luar preview.
workflow.expectedEn: Offline review uses validated saved bytes without requiring a new connection to the original device.
workflow.expectedId: Review offline memakai byte tersimpan yang tervalidasi tanpa perlu koneksi baru ke perangkat asal.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: A mismatched or incomplete archive should be rejected/flagged; do not manually alter hash or raw stream to force it open.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Arsip yang tidak lengkap atau tidak cocok harus ditolak/ditandai; jangan mengubah hash atau raw stream untuk memaksa dibuka.

sections.headingEn: Export trace text and event CSV
sections.headingId: Ekspor teks trace dan CSV event
paragraphsEn: Trace TXT exports selected trace rows, or all currently visible trace rows when none are selected. Events offers its own CSV export scope.
paragraphsId: Trace TXT mengekspor baris trace terpilih, atau seluruh baris trace yang sedang terlihat jika tidak ada yang dipilih. Events menyediakan ekspor CSV dengan cakupan tersendiri.

stepsEn: Filter and select raw frames that support the issue.
Click Trace TXT in the action rail and check the written text file.
For event records open Events and choose Export CSV.
Choose between filtered and available indexed event scope where offered.
Verify column headers, direction, timestamps and file scope against the original trace.
stepsId: Filter dan pilih raw frame yang mendukung masalah.
Klik Trace TXT pada action rail lalu periksa file teks yang dibuat.
Untuk catatan event buka Events dan pilih Export CSV.
Pilih cakupan event terfilter atau indexed sesuai opsi yang ditawarkan.
Cek header kolom, arah, timestamp dan cakupan file dibanding trace asal.
workflow.expectedEn: Plain-text and CSV extracts are useful for sharing selected evidence while the canonical .ariec retains richer raw context.
workflow.expectedId: Ekstrak teks dan CSV berguna untuk berbagi evidence terpilih sedangkan .ariec canonical mempertahankan konteks raw lebih kaya.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Visible rows might be filtered or preview-limited; do not represent a filtered TXT/CSV as the whole field capture.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Baris terlihat dapat terfilter atau terbatas preview; jangan menyatakan TXT/CSV terfilter sebagai seluruh capture lapangan.

sections.headingEn: Preview and export a PDF report
paragraphsEn: Report provides a preview and the left action rail's Report action exports a professional PDF using ArSee's native report engine.
paragraphsId: Report menyediakan preview dan action Report pada rail kiri mengekspor PDF profesional dengan engine report bawaan ArSee.

stepsEn: First run a session or open a validated capture with evidence rows.
Open Report workspace, refresh preview if necessary and verify its evidence scope.
Inspect report pages and select source rows that actually support your conclusion.
Click Report on the left rail to export PDF, choose a destination and save.
Open the exported PDF and inspect station names, times, decoded fields and completeness before sharing.
stepsId: Jalankan sesi atau buka capture valid yang memiliki baris evidence.
Buka workspace Report, refresh preview bila perlu dan verifikasi cakupan evidence.
Periksa halaman laporan serta baris sumber yang benar-benar mendukung kesimpulan.
Klik Report pada rail kiri untuk ekspor PDF, pilih lokasi lalu simpan.
Buka PDF hasilnya dan periksa nama stasiun, waktu, field decode serta kelengkapan sebelum berbagi.
workflow.expectedEn: The PDF corresponds to the current evidence scope and includes engineering context suitable for FAT/SAT review.
workflow.expectedId: PDF sesuai cakupan evidence saat ini dan memuat konteks engineering untuk review FAT/SAT.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: No evidence rows means export is refused; first connect/run or open a valid capture. A PDF is a documented observation, not automatic compliance certification.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Tanpa baris evidence ekspor ditolak; jalankan sesi atau buka capture valid dahulu. PDF adalah observasi terdokumentasi, bukan sertifikasi compliance otomatis.

sections.headingEn: Protect field and customer information
paragraphsEn: Captures, profiles and reports may contain station names, IP addresses, COM numbers, raw frames, signal names and time-correlated operational data.
paragraphsId: Capture, profil dan laporan dapat berisi nama stasiun, alamat IP, nomor COM, frame raw, nama sinyal serta data operasi terkait waktu.

stepsEn: Before sharing, identify whether the audience is project-internal or public.
Review every filename, report header, profile and raw frame for customer data.
Keep unsanitized captures only in an approved storage location.
For public examples use the built-in demo or independently constructed synthetic frames.
Never replace real project evidence with fictitious byte sequences without explicitly declaring simulation.
stepsId: Sebelum berbagi, tentukan apakah penerimanya internal proyek atau publik.
Periksa nama file, header laporan, profil dan setiap frame raw terkait data pelanggan.
Simpan capture asli hanya di lokasi yang disetujui.
Untuk contoh publik gunakan demo bawaan atau frame sintetis yang dibuat independen.
Jangan mengganti evidence proyek asli dengan byte fiktif tanpa menyatakan simulasi secara eksplisit.
workflow.expectedEn: Project evidence remains traceable while public learning examples contain no customer-specific configuration.
workflow.expectedId: Evidence proyek tetap dapat ditelusuri sementara contoh belajar publik tidak berisi konfigurasi pelanggan.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Checksum/manifest integrity proves file consistency, not that a USB adapter or operator captured every physical bit correctly.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Integritas checksum/manifest membuktikan konsistensi file, bukan bahwa adapter USB atau operator menangkap setiap bit fisik tanpa kehilangan.

chapters.summaryEn: Diagnose missing communication or mismatched values layer by layer instead of trying random settings.
chapters.summaryId: Diagnosis komunikasi hilang atau value tidak cocok berdasarkan lapisan, bukan mengganti pengaturan acak.
chapters.searchText: Troubleshooting and common questions Troubleshooting dan pertanyaan umum Diagnose missing communication or mismatched values layer by layer instead of trying random settings. Diagnosis komunikasi hilang atau value tidak cocok berdasarkan lapisan, bukan mengganti pengaturan acak. Connect succeeds but no data arrives Connect berhasil tetapi tidak ada data Values or event names look wrong Nama Values atau event terlihat salah GI incomplete, event missing or duplicate GI tidak lengkap, event hilang atau duplikat Help Center, search and contextual F1 Help Center, pencarian dan F1 kontekstual

sections.headingEn: Connect succeeds but no data arrives
sections.headingId: Connect berhasil tetapi tidak ada data
paragraphsEn: A green/connected state only proves a subset of transport conditions. It cannot prove a working station image or reporting pipeline.
paragraphsId: Indikator connected hanya membuktikan sebagian kondisi transport. Itu belum membuktikan station image atau reporting pipeline bekerja.

stepsEn: Identify which protocol and live/demo target is selected.
In Raw Frames distinguish no TX, TX without RX, RX malformed, and RX valid but no application ASDU.
For serial, verify COM, baud, parity, link address, flow control, ACD/DFC and request function.
For IEC104, verify STARTDT con and I-frame application data after TCP connect.
Only then inspect CA/IOA/FUN-INF mapping and event generation.
stepsId: Identifikasi protokol dan target live/demo yang dipilih.
Di Raw Frames bedakan tidak ada TX, TX tanpa RX, RX rusak, serta RX valid tetapi tanpa ASDU aplikasi.
Untuk serial, verifikasi COM, baud, parity, link address, flow control, ACD/DFC dan function request.
Untuk IEC104, verifikasi STARTDT con dan data aplikasi I-frame setelah TCP connect.
Baru setelah itu periksa mapping CA/IOA/FUN-INF serta pembentukan event.
workflow.expectedEn: The investigation points to the first unproven layer and records exact raw evidence for retest.
workflow.expectedId: Investigasi menunjukkan lapisan pertama yang belum terbukti dan menyimpan evidence raw untuk uji ulang.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Do not infer a wiring fault merely from an empty Values list or a blinking TX/RX LED.
workflow.troubleshootingId: Jangan menyimpulkan wiring salah hanya karena Values kosong atau LED TX/RX berkedip.

sections.headingEn: Values or event names look wrong
sections.headingId: Nama Values atau event terlihat salah
paragraphsEn: A valid raw frame may be assigned a wrong human label if the selected Signal List maps the wrong CA/IOA or relay FUN/INF.
paragraphsId: Frame raw valid dapat mendapat label manusia yang salah jika Signal List terpilih memetakan CA/IOA atau FUN/INF relay secara keliru.

stepsEn: Select the suspicious row and open original source frame.
Verify raw station address, Type ID, COT, CA/IOA or FUN/INF.
Compare the mapping profile and approved signal list revision.
Check quality bits and timestamp before drawing a field conclusion.
Correct the project-owned map, then re-open/review evidence; retain original raw bytes.
stepsId: Pilih baris mencurigakan dan buka frame sumber asli.
Verifikasi station address, Type ID, COT, CA/IOA atau FUN/INF raw.
Bandingkan mapping profile dengan revisi signal list yang disetujui.
Cek quality bit dan timestamp sebelum menarik kesimpulan lapangan.
Perbaiki map milik proyek, lalu review evidence lagi; simpan byte asli.
workflow.expectedEn: Label, raw address and engineering meaning agree with the approved project signal list.
workflow.expectedId: Label, address raw dan makna engineering cocok dengan signal list proyek yang disetujui.
workflow.troubleshootingEn: Never hide mismatch by silently rewriting the captured CA/IOA or asserting good quality that the device did not send.

chapters.summaryEn: A structured map of telecontrol, master/outstation roles, data layers and field engineering vocabulary.
chapters.summaryId: Peta telecontrol, peran master/outstation, lapisan data, dan istilah dasar untuk commissioning.

sections.headingEn: What this family solves
paragraphsEn: IEC 60870 defines conventions for exchanging telecontrol information between a control center and remote equipment. The IEC 60870-5 transmission-protocol family includes companion standards selected for a particular use case; a product claiming IEC 60870 support is not automatically interoperable without matching its companion standard and interoperability profile.

A supervisory master reads indications, measurements, counters and events, and may issue approved controls. An outstation (RTU, gateway or IED) owns process information, mapping and source quality. A gateway can translate another field protocol into IEC objects; translation does not make the original source event or timestamp identical.
paragraphsId: IEC 60870 mendefinisikan konvensi pertukaran informasi telekontrol antara pusat kendali dan peralatan lapangan. Keluarga protokol transmisi IEC 60870-5 mencakup companion standard sesuai kebutuhan; perangkat yang disebut mendukung IEC 60870 belum tentu interoperable sebelum companion standard dan profil interoperability-nya cocok.

Master SCADA membaca status, analog, counter dan event serta dapat mengirim kontrol yang diotorisasi. Outstation (RTU, gateway atau IED) memiliki data proses, mapping dan kualitas sumber. Gateway dapat menerjemahkan protokol lain menjadi objek IEC; penerjemahan tidak otomatis menyamakan timestamp dan kejadian asli sumber.
bulletsEn: Distinguish IEC 101 serial telecontrol, IEC 103 protection equipment, and IEC 104 TCP/IP telecontrol.
Read the project-specific interoperability list: supported Type IDs, COT, address widths, timers, serial mode and control qualifiers.
Separate IEC normative rules, selected companion-standard options, deployment conventions and local engineering policy.
bulletsId: Bedakan IEC 101 telecontrol serial, IEC 103 untuk peralatan proteksi, dan IEC 104 telecontrol melalui TCP/IP.
Periksa interoperability list proyek: Type ID, COT, panjang address, timer, mode serial, dan qualifier kontrol.
Pisahkan ketentuan normatif IEC, opsi companion standard, konvensi deployment, dan kebijakan engineering lokal.

sections.headingEn: Read the layers in order
paragraphsEn: A correct-looking TX/RX LED proves only that something moved. Work from physical/TCP connectivity to link or APCI control, ASDU header, information objects, process quality, and transaction outcomes. Do not diagnose an IOA mapping problem before proving that a valid ASDU arrived.

The ASDU normally identifies a type, sequence arrangement, cause of transmission and common address; information objects then describe address, value, quality and optional time. Exact field layouts are profile-dependent and IEC 103 uses a different protection-oriented model from IEC 101/104.
paragraphsId: LED TX/RX menyala hanya membuktikan ada aktivitas. Periksa bertahap: fisik/TCP, kontrol link atau APCI, header ASDU, objek informasi, kualitas proses, hingga hasil transaksi. Jangan menyimpulkan masalah mapping IOA sebelum terbukti ASDU valid diterima.

ASDU lazimnya memuat tipe, susunan urutan, cause of transmission, dan common address; objek informasi menunjukkan alamat, nilai, kualitas, dan waktu opsional. Ukuran field bergantung profil; IEC 103 memiliki model proteksi yang berbeda dari IEC 101/104.
bulletsEn: Trace bytes are evidence; a decoded label is an interpretation of that evidence.
A link acknowledgment does not equal application confirmation or physical breaker operation.
Record the IEC edition, companion options, and profile version before FAT/SAT.
bulletsId: Byte trace adalah evidence; label hasil decode merupakan interpretasi evidence.
ACK level link bukan konfirmasi aplikasi maupun bukti pemutus tenaga telah bergerak.
Catat edisi IEC, opsi companion, dan versi profil sebelum FAT/SAT.

sections.headingEn: Master, outstation and time
paragraphsEn: For unbalanced serial IEC 101/103, the controlling station initiates link transactions while a secondary station responds; an unrequested secondary transmission is not the normal unbalanced pattern. IEC 104 uses TCP and controlled APCI data-transfer state, so it is not correct to describe IEC 104 as Class 1/Class 2 serial polling.

Distinguish source timestamps embedded in an event from host receive time. Check time-sync configuration, CP56Time2a decoding, local time-zone interpretation and clock accuracy before attributing a sequence problem to the RTU.
paragraphsId: Pada IEC 101/103 serial unbalanced, controlling station menginisiasi transaksi link dan secondary station merespons; pengiriman sekunder tanpa permintaan bukan pola umum unbalanced. IEC 104 memakai TCP dengan status data transfer APCI, sehingga tidak tepat menyebut IEC 104 menggunakan polling serial Class 1/Class 2.
Bedakan timestamp dari perangkat pada event dengan waktu penerimaan komputer. Periksa sinkronisasi jam, decoding CP56Time2a, zona waktu, dan akurasi jam sebelum menyimpulkan ada masalah urutan event.
bulletsEn: Connection established is not proof of correct application data.
Report unknown/invalid quality without inventing a trustworthy Good state.
Keep the original byte source whenever a decoded value is disputed.
bulletsId: Koneksi berhasil belum membuktikan data aplikasi benar.
Laporkan kualitas unknown/invalid tanpa mengarang status Good.
Simpan byte sumber saat hasil decode diperdebatkan.

sections.headingEn: Interoperability is a contract, not a checkbox
paragraphsEn: Two products can both support IEC 60870-5-101 yet disagree on address field widths, balance mode, Type IDs, COT, quality semantics, timers and control qualifiers. The agreed interoperability list describes which standard options a particular pair of systems actually use. Document this before investigating a silent link.

During FAT, verify at least one positive and one negative case for each supported service. Unsupported Type ID or negative activation confirmation is meaningful evidence; treating it as successful data is a decoding error.
paragraphsId: Dua perangkat sama-sama mendukung IEC 60870-5-101 tetapi masih bisa berbeda pada panjang address, balanced mode, Type ID, COT, quality, timer dan qualifier kontrol. Interoperability list yang disepakati menunjukkan opsi standar yang benar-benar digunakan oleh sistem tersebut. Catat sebelum menelusuri link yang diam.

Saat FAT, verifikasi setidaknya satu kasus positif dan negatif setiap layanan yang didukung. Type ID yang tidak didukung atau negative activation confirmation adalah evidence penting; memperlakukannya sebagai data sukses merupakan kesalahan decoding.
bulletsEn: Freeze protocol edition, companion profile, address lengths and station mapping in the evidence header.
Keep transport validity, protocol validity and business/process validity as separate verdicts.
bulletsId: Bekukan edisi protokol, companion profile, panjang address serta mapping stasiun di header evidence.
Pisahkan verdict validitas transport, validitas protokol dan validitas proses.

sections.headingEn: A beginner's five questions for every frame
sections.headingId: Lima pertanyaan pemula untuk setiap frame
paragraphsEn: A good analyzer should answer: who sent this, which link/session carried it, what layer accepted it, why was the ASDU sent, and what point or command transaction does it affect? Read a frame in that order to avoid confusing a correct link acknowledgment with a successful breaker operation.
paragraphsId: Analyzer yang baik menjawab: siapa pengirimnya, link/session apa yang membawanya, layer apa yang menerimanya, mengapa ASDU dikirim, serta point atau transaksi command mana yang terdampak? Baca frame dengan urutan tersebut agar ACK link tidak disamakan dengan keberhasilan operasi breaker.
bulletsEn: Identify TX/RX from the actual capture point, not assumed device role.
Validate framing/checksum or APCI before ASDU interpretation.
Check mapping/quality/time before making an operational conclusion.
bulletsId: Tentukan TX/RX dari titik capture sebenarnya, bukan asumsi peran perangkat.
Validasi framing/checksum atau APCI sebelum menafsirkan ASDU.
Cek mapping/quality/waktu sebelum menyimpulkan operasi proses.

sections.headingEn: Capture viewpoint and direction
paragraphsEn: TX and RX labels are relative to the equipment performing the capture. On a passive tap, identify which physical conductor or logical TCP endpoint each direction represents before naming the sender as master or outstation.

For serial links, parity/framing faults and RS-485 turnaround timing can corrupt an otherwise correct application request. For IEC 104, TCP segmentation and retransmission are not equivalent to protocol APDU boundaries.
paragraphsId: Label TX dan RX bergantung perangkat pencatat. Pada tap pasif, identifikasi penghantar fisik atau endpoint TCP setiap arah sebelum menyebut pengirim sebagai master atau outstation.
Pada link serial, kesalahan parity/framing dan waktu turnaround RS-485 dapat merusak request aplikasi yang benar. Pada IEC 104, TCP segmentation dan retransmission bukan batas APDU protokol.
bulletsEn: Preserve port, direction, wall-clock time and capture uncertainty.
Separate checksum/framing failure from semantically unsupported ASDU.
Never invent unobserved reverse-direction bytes.
bulletsId: Simpan port, arah, waktu capture dan ketidakpastiannya.
Pisahkan kegagalan checksum/framing dari ASDU yang tidak didukung secara semantik.
Jangan mengarang byte arah sebaliknya yang tidak terlihat.

sections.headingEn: Trust ladder: byte to application conclusion
sections.headingId: Tangga kepercayaan: byte hingga kesimpulan aplikasi
paragraphsEn: Step 1 proves byte capture completeness; step 2 proves transport/link validity; step 3 proves ASDU decode under selected profile; step 4 correlates an object to a configured point; step 5 correlates a command to confirmed field feedback. A failure at an earlier step prevents claiming later certainty.
This order prevents a misleading 'connected' banner from becoming a false FAT PASS when the observed Common Address, relay FUN/INF or process quality is wrong.
paragraphsId: Langkah 1 membuktikan kelengkapan capture; langkah 2 membuktikan validitas transport/link; langkah 3 membuktikan decode ASDU sesuai profil; langkah 4 menghubungkan objek ke point konfigurasi; langkah 5 mencocokkan command dengan feedback lapangan. Kegagalan langkah awal tidak membenarkan kepastian langkah akhir.
Urutan ini mencegah banner 'connected' berubah menjadi FAT PASS yang salah ketika Common Address, FUN/INF relay atau quality proses ternyata keliru.
bulletsEn: Use labels Observed, Correlated, Inferred and Not observed.
A valid byte stream is not automatically a valid control result.
bulletsId: Gunakan label Observed, Correlated, Inferred dan Not observed.
Aliran byte valid belum otomatis berarti hasil kontrol valid.

sections.headingEn: Two conceptual capture patterns
paragraphsEn: Do not treat the following examples as real complete transmittable frames; they describe layers and expected events, not exact checksum bytes. Match them to real captures when learning.

Pattern A: master sends serial Class 2 request, RTU replies with no-data. Pattern B: client establishes IEC 104 TCP, completes STARTDT, sends GI I-frame, and receives ACTCON plus process ASDUs. In either case the ASDU must still be checked against the negotiated station map.
paragraphsId: Jangan memperlakukan contoh berikut sebagai frame lengkap yang siap dikirim; contoh ini menjelaskan layer dan kejadian yang diharapkan, bukan byte checksum yang tepat. Cocokkan dengan capture nyata saat belajar.

Pola A: master mengirim request Class 2 serial, RTU membalas no-data. Pola B: client membuka TCP IEC 104, menyelesaikan STARTDT, mengirim I-frame GI, lalu menerima ACTCON dan ASDU proses. Pada keduanya ASDU tetap perlu dibandingkan dengan station map yang disepakati.

B / TCP: connect -> STARTDT act/con -> GI act -> ACTCON -> data -> completion

B / TCP: connect -> STARTDT act/con -> GI act -> ACTCON -> data -> selesai

sections.headingEn: Link frame anatomy
paragraphsEn: IEC 101 is a serial telecontrol companion standard. Its FT1.2 link procedure uses fixed-length, variable-length and short acknowledgement forms as configured and permitted by the selected profile. Correct framing, checksum, control field and link address are prerequisites before interpreting ASDU data.

The link address names a link-layer station; the Common Address names the application station; an Information Object Address identifies a point. They solve different problems and must not be substituted for each other.
paragraphsId: IEC 101 adalah companion standard telecontrol serial. Prosedur link FT1.2 menggunakan frame fixed-length, variable-length dan bentuk acknowledgement singkat sesuai profil yang dipilih. Framing, checksum, control field serta link address harus benar sebelum membaca ASDU.
Link address menunjukkan stasiun di lapisan link; Common Address menunjukkan stasiun aplikasi; Information Object Address menunjukkan point. Ketiganya berbeda dan tidak boleh saling dipertukarkan.
bulletsEn: Check 0x10 fixed, 0x68 variable and context-sensitive 0xE5 acknowledgement forms when permitted.
The control field includes primary/secondary direction and function; FCB/FCV tracks request sequence validity.
Verify configured link address width and COT/CA/IOA octet widths; never infer all widths globally.
bulletsId: Periksa frame fixed 0x10, variable 0x68 dan ACK 0xE5 yang kontekstual sesuai profil.
Control field menjelaskan arah primary/secondary dan function; FCB/FCV menjaga validitas urutan request.
Verifikasi lebar link address dan panjang COT/CA/IOA yang dikonfigurasi; jangan mengasumsikannya global.
framesEn: Conceptual link exchange: TX primary request → RX secondary response.
A link ACK is not ACTCON; record both layers separately.
framesId: Pertukaran link konseptual: TX request primary → RX response secondary.
Link ACK bukan ACTCON; catat kedua lapisan terpisah.

sections.headingEn: Healthy unbalanced Class 2 / Class 1 polling
sections.headingId: Polling unbalanced Class 2 / Class 1 yang sehat
paragraphsEn: In unbalanced IEC 101 the master normally performs background Class 2 polls. A secondary response can advertise ACD=1 (higher-priority data pending). The master then requests Class 1 in a bounded drain and returns to normal polling when pending data is exhausted or the profile-defined stopping condition is met.

DFC=1 is a link-layer busy/flow-control indication, not an event-buffer overflow value. The master must respect busy behavior rather than sending faster in response. For no-data responses, do not continuously request Class 1 when there is no evidence of pending Class 1 data.
paragraphsId: Pada IEC 101 unbalanced, master lazimnya polling Class 2 sebagai latar belakang. Respons secondary dapat menandai ACD=1 (data prioritas lebih tinggi menunggu). Master kemudian melakukan drain Class 1 secara terbatas dan kembali ke polling normal setelah antrian kosong atau kondisi berhenti sesuai profil tercapai.

DFC=1 adalah indikasi busy/flow-control di lapisan link, bukan nilai overflow buffer event. Master harus menghormati kondisi busy, bukan mempercepat request. Ketika respons no-data, jangan terus meminta Class 1 tanpa indikasi data Class 1 menunggu.
bulletsEn: ACD=0: continue normal Class 2/background scan; do not force perpetual Class 1.
ACD=1: request bounded Class 1, acknowledge valid data and monitor successive ACD/no-data responses.
DFC=1: use configured backoff/retry; surface busy and timeout evidence.
Use separate counters for polls, no-data, valid ASDUs, retransmits and command milestones.
bulletsId: ACD=0: lanjutkan scan Class 2 normal; jangan memaksa Class 1 terus-menerus.
ACD=1: lakukan Class 1 drain terbatas, ACK data valid dan amati ACD/no-data berikutnya.
DFC=1: lakukan backoff/retry sesuai konfigurasi; tampilkan evidence busy dan timeout.
Pisahkan counter polling, no-data, ASDU valid, retransmit, dan milestone kontrol.
framesEn: TX  Request Class 2
RX  Data (ACD=0) / no-data
RX  Data (ACD=1) → TX Request Class 1
RX  Event(s), then no pending Class 1 → resume Class 2
framesId: TX  Request Class 2
RX  Data (ACD=0) / no-data
RX  Data (ACD=1) → TX Request Class 1
RX  Event, lalu Class 1 habis → lanjut Class 2

sections.headingEn: Startup, GI and command evidence
paragraphsEn: A common startup is: open serial link, establish/reset link state as configured, validate link communication, optionally synchronize the clock, activate General Interrogation and observe the ASDU response sequence. GI obtains a snapshot; it is not a replacement for normal event-drain rules.

For a controlled command, keep select/execute qualifiers, ACT/ACTCON, any negative confirmation, optional ACTTERM, and independent process-state feedback. A link ACK or positive ACTCON means only that a particular stage was acknowledged—it does not prove the breaker changed state.
paragraphsId: Startup yang umum: buka serial, inisialisasi/reset status link sesuai konfigurasi, verifikasi komunikasi, sinkronisasi waktu bila digunakan, aktifkan General Interrogation dan amati urutan respons ASDU. GI mengambil snapshot, bukan menggantikan aturan drain event normal.

Untuk command, simpan qualifier select/execute, ACT/ACTCON, konfirmasi negatif, ACTTERM opsional, dan feedback proses independen. ACK link atau ACTCON positif hanya membuktikan tahap terkait dikonfirmasi, bukan bukti breaker berubah keadaan.
bulletsEn: GI data may arrive as multiple ASDUs; completion requires the applicable termination/evidence, not a guessed expected row count.
FCB handling and duplicates depend on the confirmed link procedure; never resend ambiguous physical controls automatically.
Keep source/CA/IOA, command phase and fresh feedback together in the report.
bulletsId: Data GI dapat tersebar di banyak ASDU; penyelesaian perlu evidence terminasi sesuai aturan, bukan jumlah row yang ditebak.
FCB dan duplikasi bergantung prosedur link yang sudah dipastikan; jangan mengulang kontrol fisik ambigu secara otomatis.
Simpan sumber/CA/IOA, fase command, dan feedback baru dalam laporan.

sections.headingEn: Fixed and variable FT1.2 frames
paragraphsEn: A fixed-length FT1.2 frame carries link-control information without an application ASDU; a variable-length frame may carry an ASDU. The short positive acknowledgment 0xE5 is valid only where that response is permitted by the link procedure and profile. A repeated start/length check and checksum can reject broken framing before any Type ID is decoded.

Treat all example bytes in this handbook as schematic unless a complete checked frame with checksum is shown. Do not paste a schematic sequence into a serial test tool as though it were a transmit-ready APDU.
paragraphsId: Frame FT1.2 fixed-length membawa informasi kontrol link tanpa ASDU aplikasi; frame variable-length dapat membawa ASDU. ACK positif singkat 0xE5 hanya valid jika prosedur link dan profil mengizinkannya. Pemeriksaan start/length berulang dan checksum menolak frame rusak sebelum Type ID di-decode.

Semua contoh byte dalam handbook ini bersifat skematis kecuali ditampilkan frame lengkap beserta checksum terverifikasi. Jangan mengirim urutan skematis melalui test tool seolah-olah merupakan APDU siap TX.
bulletsEn: 0x10: investigate fixed-length link request/response; 0x68: investigate variable-length frame and ASDU.
0xE5 is a context-dependent short acknowledgement, not an application ACTCON.
Reject a length/checksum mismatch without inventing missing ASDU values.
bulletsId: 0x10: cek request/response link fixed-length; 0x68: cek frame variable-length beserta ASDU.
0xE5 merupakan ACK pendek sesuai konteks, bukan ACTCON aplikasi.
Tolak length/checksum mismatch tanpa mengarang ASDU yang hilang.
framesEn: Schematic: [START][LENGTH][CONTROL][LINK ADDRESS][ASDU?][CHECKSUM][END]
framesId: Skematis: [START][LENGTH][CONTROL][LINK ADDRESS][ASDU?][CHECKSUM][END]

sections.headingEn: How the RTU must react to an empty event queue
sections.headingId: Bagaimana RTU merespons antrian event kosong
paragraphsEn: After a valid Class 1 request on an empty queue, the RTU should return the permitted no-data response in the selected procedure, not manufacture a stale event or silently hold the serial line. A good master recognizes no-data and stops the Class 1 drain within a configured bound.

If Class 1 never empties, test event-classification pressure, accidental cyclic high-priority generation and buffer behavior before increasing polling speed. ACD=1 is a hint of priority data pending, not proof that the next frame contains a usable event.
paragraphsId: Sesudah request Class 1 yang valid saat antrian kosong, RTU seharusnya mengirim respons no-data yang diperbolehkan prosedur terpilih, bukan membuat event lama atau menahan jalur serial tanpa respons. Master yang baik mengenali no-data dan menghentikan drain Class 1 dalam batas terkonfigurasi.

Jika Class 1 tidak pernah habis, uji beban klasifikasi event, data periodik yang salah diberi prioritas tinggi dan perilaku buffer sebelum menaikkan kecepatan polling. ACD=1 adalah indikasi data prioritas menunggu, bukan jaminan frame berikut berisi event yang dapat dipakai.
bulletsEn: Capture the request FC, secondary response FC, ACD, DFC and raw frame integrity.
No-data on a healthy empty queue is not a communications failure.
Do not starve Class 2/background scans when Class 1 keeps reasserting ACD.
bulletsId: Capture request FC, response FC, ACD, DFC dan integritas frame mentah.
No-data saat antrian sehat kosong bukan kegagalan komunikasi.
Jangan membuat Class 2/background scan kelaparan ketika Class 1 terus menunjukkan ACD.

RX RTU     No data (queue empty)

0x49 + 0x01 = 0x4A, sehingga checksum FT1.2 cocok.
lab.questionEn: Is the RTU expected to answer with measurement ASDUs?
lab.questionId: Haruskah RTU membalas dengan ASDU pengukuran?
lab.answerEn: No. This is primary link-status FC9. Expect a permitted secondary link-status response such as FC11, subject to profile and actual link state.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Ini link-status FC9 dari primary. Yang diharapkan respons status link secondary seperti FC11 sesuai profil dan kondisi link yang benar.

sections.headingEn: Secondary link-status response
paragraphsEn: A valid status response can be a complete fixed FT1.2 frame. Decoding the direction and secondary function is necessary: a positive status response cannot be inferred from a packet count or from an uncorrelated single byte.
This constructed example keeps the same one-octet station address. It is a separate response frame, not a combined multi-frame telegram.
paragraphsId: Respons status link valid dapat berupa frame fixed FT1.2 lengkap. Arah dan fungsi secondary harus di-decode: keberhasilan status tidak bisa ditebak dari jumlah packet atau satu byte tanpa korelasi.
Contoh ini memakai address stasiun satu oktet yang sama. Ini frame respons tersendiri, bukan telegram gabungan beberapa frame.
bulletsEn: PRM=0 identifies a secondary response in the selected unbalanced procedure.
Secondary FC11 is link-status/access-demand context, not application ACTCON.
bulletsId: PRM=0 menandai respons secondary pada prosedur unbalanced yang dipilih.
Secondary FC11 menunjukkan konteks status link/access-demand, bukan ACTCON aplikasi.

lab.scenarioEn: RTU answers a preceding valid link-status request.
lab.scenarioId: RTU menjawab request link-status yang valid.
stepsEn: 0x0B + 0x01 = 0x0C checksum.
No ASDU: the result establishes only link-service evidence.
stepsId: 0x0B + 0x01 = 0x0C checksum.
Tidak ada ASDU: bukti ini hanya menetapkan layanan link.
lab.questionEn: Does this prove General Interrogation completed?
lab.questionId: Apakah ini membuktikan GI selesai?
lab.answerEn: No. A link-status reply contains no GI Type ID, COT, point image or completion evidence.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Respons link-status tidak berisi Type ID GI, COT, image point atau evidence penyelesaian GI.

sections.headingEn: Class 2 request and an empty buffer
paragraphsEn: A master in unbalanced operation normally requests background Class 2 data. Its request is a link-layer service with function code 11, not a spontaneous ASDU. In the example, FCV=1 and FCB=0; correct FCB evolution across repeated requests depends on established link state.
A valid secondary no-data FC9 is a normal outcome when nothing is queued. The master should continue the agreed scan and not report an RTU outage from an empty queue.
paragraphsId: Master pada operasi unbalanced umumnya meminta data background Class 2. Request ini layanan lapisan link dengan function code 11, bukan ASDU spontan. Pada contoh, FCV=1 dan FCB=0; evolusi FCB pada request berikutnya bergantung state link yang sudah terbentuk.
No-data secondary FC9 yang valid merupakan hasil normal saat antrian kosong. Master seharusnya melanjutkan scan yang disepakati dan tidak menyatakan RTU gagal dari antrian kosong.
bulletsEn: Verify the link was initialized before reasoning about FCB/FCV.
A no-data frame is different from silence or checksum failure.
bulletsId: Pastikan link sudah diinisialisasi sebelum menilai FCB/FCV.
Frame no-data berbeda dari tidak ada respons maupun checksum rusak.

lab.scenarioEn: A master sends one Class 2 request after proper link initialization.
lab.scenarioId: Master mengirim satu request Class 2 setelah inisialisasi link benar.
stepsEn: 0x5B = PRM + FCV + primary FC11 (Class 2 request).
0x5B + 0x01 = 0x5C checksum.
stepsId: 0x5B = PRM + FCV + primary FC11 (request Class 2).
0x5B + 0x01 = 0x5C checksum.
lab.questionEn: If the RTU has no Class 2 data, is lack of an event necessarily a fault?
lab.questionId: Jika RTU tidak memiliki data Class 2, apakah tidak adanya event selalu fault?
lab.answerEn: No. A permitted no-data response is healthy. Investigate no response, malformed bytes, or wrongly persistent ACD independently.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Respons no-data yang diperbolehkan menunjukkan kondisi sehat. Selidiki tidak adanya respons, byte rusak, atau ACD menetap secara terpisah.

sections.headingEn: A single-byte E5 must stay context-sensitive
sections.headingId: Byte tunggal E5 harus tetap kontekstual
paragraphsEn: A lone 0xE5 carries no link address, ACD/DFC or function-code field. In IEC 101 procedures where a short response is permitted, the same raw byte can stand for a positive link acknowledgement or an empty Class 1/Class 2 response, depending on the uniquely matched outstanding request.
A link-status FC9 service expects a proper status answer and must not be certified by an uncorrelated E5. This exercise proves byte recognition, not the semantic role of E5 without context.
paragraphsId: Byte tunggal 0xE5 tidak memuat link address, ACD/DFC maupun field function code. Pada prosedur IEC 101 yang mengizinkan short response, byte mentah yang sama dapat mewakili ACK link positif atau respons Class 1/Class 2 kosong, sesuai request tertunda yang unik dan cocok.
Layanan link-status FC9 mengharapkan respons status yang tepat dan tidak boleh dinyatakan berhasil dari E5 tanpa korelasi. Latihan ini membuktikan pengenalan byte, bukan makna E5 tanpa konteks.
bulletsEn: Keep the raw label E5; inferred function must be clearly marked as inferred.
Never fabricate an address or ACD=0 inside a byte that has no such fields.
bulletsId: Pertahankan label raw E5; function hasil korelasi harus ditandai inferred.
Jangan mengarang address atau ACD=0 dalam byte yang tidak memuat field tersebut.

lab.scenarioEn: Only one octet is observed, without a matching request in this capture.
lab.scenarioId: Hanya satu oktet terlihat, tanpa request pendamping pada capture ini.
stepsEn: Valid short response byte under applicable IEC101 procedure.
The request, address, ACD and whether it was ACK/no-data are unobserved.
stepsId: Byte short response valid sesuai prosedur IEC101 yang berlaku.
Request, address, ACD serta apakah ACK/no-data tidak teramati.
lab.questionEn: Can ArSee label this as confirmed Class 1 no-data with ACD=0?
lab.questionId: Bolehkah ArSee menyebutnya Class 1 no-data terkonfirmasi dengan ACD=0?
lab.answerEn: No. The raw byte has no function/address/ACD fields. Correlation to an outstanding compatible poll is needed; otherwise label semantic outcome unknown.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Byte mentah ini tidak memiliki field function/address/ACD. Dibutuhkan korelasi request poll kompatibel yang unik; tanpa itu makna semantik unknown.

sections.headingEn: Bad checksum versus invalid one-byte A2
sections.headingId: Checksum salah versus byte A2 yang tidak sah
paragraphsEn: This example differs from the first fixed frame by one checksum bit. The frame is structurally shaped like FT1.2 but invalid; do not trust any parsed function as a valid transaction response. A solitary 0xA2 must likewise not be accepted as a valid IEC 101 short NACK merely because another serial convention uses that value.
The useful question is which layer failed: byte integrity, application support, or missing capture context.
paragraphsId: Contoh ini berbeda dari frame fixed pertama hanya pada satu bit checksum. Bentuknya menyerupai FT1.2 namun tidak valid; jangan mempercayai function hasil decode sebagai transaksi valid. Byte tunggal 0xA2 juga tidak boleh dianggap short NACK IEC 101 yang sah hanya karena konvensi serial lain memakai nilainya.
Pertanyaan utama adalah layer apa yang gagal: integritas byte, dukungan aplikasi, atau konteks capture yang belum lengkap.
bulletsEn: 0x49 + 0x01 gives 0x4A, not 0x4B.
Do not treat invalid bytes as a positive FAT proof.
bulletsId: 0x49 + 0x01 menghasilkan 0x4A, bukan 0x4B.
Jangan gunakan byte tidak valid sebagai FAT proof positif.

lab.scenarioEn: Serial capture includes a damaged checksum in an otherwise fixed-looking request.
lab.scenarioId: Capture serial memuat checksum rusak pada request yang tampak fixed.
stepsEn: Visible start/end and station address do not override checksum failure.
Retain original bytes and report invalid integrity first.
stepsId: Start/end serta address yang terlihat tidak menghapus kegagalan checksum.
Pertahankan byte asli dan laporkan integritas tidak valid terlebih dahulu.
lab.questionEn: Should this be counted as a successful link-status request?
lab.questionId: Haruskah ini dihitung sebagai request link-status yang sukses?
lab.answerEn: No. It is a corrupted frame. A permissive-looking control field is not enough to claim an accepted link service.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Frame ini rusak. Control field yang tampak wajar tidak cukup untuk mengklaim layanan link diterima.

chapters.summaryEn: Protection-relay serial communication, polling, events and FUN/INF decoding.
chapters.summaryId: Komunikasi serial relay proteksi, polling, event dan decoding FUN/INF.
chapters.searchText: 103 protection relay secondary station fun inf generic asdu scanning time tag

sections.headingEn: Why IEC 103 is different
paragraphsEn: IEC 103 is a companion standard for the informative interface of protection equipment. It focuses on relay status, protection events, measurements and applicable generic services; an IEC 103 record must not be decoded as an IEC 101 IOA just because both can use serial link frames.

IEC 103 interpretation involves function type (FUN) and information number (INF), alongside ASDU type, cause and relay time. Meaning for manufacturer-specific or generic objects depends on a verified interoperability sheet and point mapping.
paragraphsId: IEC 103 adalah companion standard untuk antarmuka informatif peralatan proteksi. Fokusnya status relay, event proteksi, pengukuran serta generic services yang sesuai; record IEC 103 tidak boleh diperlakukan sebagai IOA IEC 101 hanya karena keduanya memakai frame serial.

Interpretasi IEC 103 melibatkan function type (FUN) dan information number (INF), bersama ASDU type, cause, dan waktu relay. Objek khusus vendor atau generic memerlukan interoperability sheet dan mapping point yang terverifikasi.
bulletsEn: Verify baud/parity, relay link address and selected profile before ASDU interpretation.
Preserve FUN/INF, Type, COT, raw cause, native time and original frame bytes.
Do not guess friendly relay labels when vendor-specific mapping is absent.
bulletsId: Verifikasi baud/parity, link address relay dan profil sebelum menafsirkan ASDU.
Pertahankan FUN/INF, Type, COT, cause asli, waktu native dan byte frame asal.
Jangan menebak nama sinyal relay tanpa mapping vendor yang terverifikasi.

sections.headingEn: How a relay should answer a serial master
sections.headingId: Pola respons relay terhadap master serial
paragraphsEn: For an unbalanced IEC 103 profile the master initiates link-level exchanges. Polling often separates background information and pending higher-priority events. When a pending indication is present, the master drains that class without repeatedly hammering an empty queue.

Relay response quality is not measured by the number of frames: a correct no-data response is valid when nothing is pending; an event should retain its information object and original relay time. Exact supported class procedures and command services are selected by the IEC 103 profile, not assumed from an IEC 101 deployment.
paragraphsId: Pada profil IEC 103 unbalanced, master menginisiasi pertukaran link. Polling biasanya membedakan informasi latar belakang dan event prioritas lebih tinggi. Saat ada data menunggu, master drain kelas itu tanpa terus menghujani antrian kosong.

Kualitas respons relay bukan diukur dari jumlah frame: no-data yang benar sah ketika tidak ada data; event harus mempertahankan objek dan timestamp asli relay. Prosedur kelas dan layanan kontrol yang didukung harus dipilih dari profil IEC 103, bukan disalin dari deployment IEC 101.
bulletsEn: Record reset/link initialization, normal scan and event drain as separate stages.
If the master sees ACD, correlate Class 1 draining with actual event ASDUs and subsequent no-data.
Compare relay clock timestamps with host arrival times without silently replacing one with another.
bulletsId: Catat reset/inisialisasi link, scan normal, dan event drain sebagai tahap terpisah.
Saat master melihat ACD, korelasikan drain Class 1 dengan ASDU event dan no-data berikutnya.
Bandingkan timestamp relay dengan waktu kedatangan komputer tanpa menggantikan salah satunya.

sections.headingEn: Relaying event evidence into SCADA
paragraphsEn: An IEC 103 protection relay may feed a gateway that exposes mapped indications through IEC 101 or 104. The protocol converter must preserve project-approved point identity, state, quality and timestamp semantics or explicitly declare what was substituted.

When the IEC 103 Activity Monitor changes but IEC 104 event logging does not, inspect the gateway's dataset/source update, COT mapping and outgoing ASDU capture. A changed local read value does not prove that a spontaneous telecontrol event was transmitted.
paragraphsId: Relay proteksi IEC 103 dapat masuk ke gateway yang mengekspos indikasi terpetakan melalui IEC 101/104. Converter harus mempertahankan identitas point, status, quality dan timestamp sesuai mapping yang disetujui, atau menyatakan penggantian data secara eksplisit.

Jika nilai pada monitor IEC 103 berubah tetapi event IEC 104 tidak muncul, periksa update sumber di gateway, mapping COT dan capture ASDU keluar. Nilai hasil read yang berubah belum membuktikan event spontan telah dikirim.
bulletsEn: Prove relay FUN/INF → gateway mapping → outgoing CA/IOA by captured evidence.
Check event-buffer overflow/loss separately from serial parity framing errors.
Treat any protection command behavior as device/project specific until compatibility is verified.
bulletsId: Buktikan FUN/INF relay → mapping gateway → CA/IOA keluar dengan capture.
Pisahkan overflow/kehilangan event dari kesalahan framing/parity serial.
Perlakukan command proteksi sebagai fitur spesifik perangkat/proyek sampai kompatibilitas dipastikan.

sections.headingEn: Relay events are not ordinary RTU points
sections.headingId: Event relay bukan point RTU biasa
paragraphsEn: A protection relay may publish start, pickup, trip and reset events carrying function/information identifiers and relay time. Do not turn those into generic breaker ON/OFF states without a verified mapping. A trip initiation event can be distinct from the actual breaker auxiliary contact feedback.

When relaying IEC 103 to an IEC 104 gateway, preserve the observed relay FUN/INF and time, then separately verify gateway Common Address, outgoing IOA and quality conversion. A gateway read that updates a value does not by itself prove spontaneous reporting.
paragraphsId: Relay proteksi dapat mengirim event start, pickup, trip dan reset dengan identitas fungsi/informasi serta waktu relay. Jangan menerjemahkannya menjadi status ON/OFF breaker umum tanpa mapping terverifikasi. Event inisiasi trip dapat berbeda dari feedback kontak bantu breaker sebenarnya.

Saat meneruskan IEC 103 ke gateway IEC 104, pertahankan FUN/INF dan waktu relay yang teramati; lalu verifikasi terpisah Common Address gateway, IOA keluar, serta konversi quality. Read gateway yang mengubah value belum otomatis membuktikan spontaneous reporting.
bulletsEn: Correlate relay signal meaning to manufacturer-approved function/information tables.
Check timestamp quality and clock synchronization before comparing sequence of protection events.
Use a decoded relay event plus subsequent gateway TX trace as conversion evidence.
bulletsId: Korelasikan arti sinyal relay dengan tabel function/information yang disetujui produsen.
Cek kualitas timestamp dan sinkronisasi jam sebelum membandingkan urutan event proteksi.
Gunakan event relay yang di-decode dan trace TX gateway berikutnya sebagai bukti konversi.

sections.headingEn: No event while relay values can be read
sections.headingId: Nilai relay terbaca tetapi tidak ada event
paragraphsEn: A master may successfully poll background/measurand information but never retrieve an event because pending priority data was not drained, the event was not mapped, or the event occurred outside the capture window. Compare ACD/no-data responses and the relay event queue while keeping timestamp/clock caveats visible.

Before calling it a relay failure, prove which request was sent, which link address responded and whether a valid relevant ASDU appeared. A lost event should never be inferred solely from an empty Events view.
paragraphsId: Master dapat sukses polling data latar belakang/measurand tetapi tidak menerima event karena data prioritas belum di-drain, event tidak dimapping, atau kejadian di luar waktu capture. Bandingkan ACD/no-data dan antrian event relay sambil menampilkan batasan timestamp/jam.

Sebelum menyebut relay gagal, buktikan request apa yang dikirim, link address yang merespons, serta apakah ASDU relevan dan valid muncul. Event hilang tidak boleh disimpulkan hanya dari tampilan Events yang kosong.
bulletsEn: If raw relay frames exist but names are missing, check FUN/INF decoding/profile first.
If no RX occurs, check serial physical/link parameters before application mapping.
If valid event ASDUs exist, verify downstream gateway point mapping independently.
bulletsId: Jika frame relay mentah ada tapi nama hilang, cek decoding FUN/INF/profil dahulu.
Jika RX tidak ada, cek fisik/parameter link serial sebelum mapping aplikasi.
Jika ASDU event valid ada, verifikasi mapping point gateway hilir secara independen.

chapters.summaryEn: Relay link proof, trip versus breaker feedback, FUN/INF and report-path gaps.
chapters.summaryId: Bukti link relay, trip versus feedback breaker, FUN/INF dan gap jalur report.
chapters.searchText: 103 lab protection relay fun inf mapping breaker gateway

sections.headingEn: Physical serial link is a separate proof
sections.headingId: Bukti link serial terpisah dari bukti aplikasi
paragraphsEn: IEC 103 can use FT1.2 link frames similar in shape to IEC 101. A status exchange proves communication at the link layer; it does not establish which protection event, FUN/INF, disturbance record or generic service a relay supports.
Use the relay's declared compatibility profile to interpret its application object model. Do not reuse an IEC 101 CA/IOA mapping for an IEC 103 function-information identifier.
paragraphsId: IEC 103 dapat memakai frame link FT1.2 yang bentuknya serupa IEC 101. Pertukaran status membuktikan komunikasi di lapisan link; belum menetapkan event proteksi, FUN/INF, disturbance record, atau generic service apa yang didukung relay.
Gunakan profil kompatibilitas relay untuk menafsirkan model objek aplikasi. Jangan memakai mapping CA/IOA IEC 101 sebagai pengganti identitas function-information IEC 103.
bulletsEn: Primary FC9 requests status, not disturbance values.
Correlate secondary link responses to the correct relay address and capture direction.
bulletsId: Primary FC9 meminta status, bukan nilai disturbance.
Korelasikan respons link secondary dengan address relay dan arah capture yang tepat.

lab.scenarioEn: The same physical FT1.2 envelope is observed on an IEC103-configured circuit.
lab.scenarioId: Envelope FT1.2 yang sama teramati pada jalur yang dikonfigurasi IEC103.
stepsEn: The bytes identify a fixed link-status request to address 1.
They do not identify IEC103 FUN/INF or a relay event.
stepsId: Byte menunjukkan request status link fixed ke address 1.
Byte tidak menunjukkan FUN/INF IEC103 atau event relay.
lab.questionEn: Can this frame alone prove a protection trip report?
lab.questionId: Dapatkah frame ini sendiri membuktikan laporan trip proteksi?
lab.answerEn: No. No application ASDU exists in this fixed frame. Only link integrity and context can be inferred.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Tidak ada ASDU aplikasi dalam frame fixed ini. Hanya integritas link dan konteks yang dapat dinilai.

sections.headingEn: Relay trip event versus breaker position
sections.headingId: Event trip relay versus posisi breaker
paragraphsEn: Protection function start, pickup or trip indications may precede or differ from physical breaker auxiliary-contact position. The presence of a correctly decoded relay event does not prove that a breaker opened.
In a controlled FAT simulator, exercise a relay event and then independently verify the breaker-position feedback that the gateway maps to the SCADA point.
paragraphsId: Indikasi start, pickup atau trip fungsi proteksi dapat lebih dahulu atau berbeda dari posisi kontak bantu breaker fisik. Event relay yang berhasil di-decode tidak membuktikan breaker telah membuka.
Dalam simulator FAT terkontrol, uji event relay lalu verifikasi feedback posisi breaker secara terpisah yang dimapping gateway ke point SCADA.
bulletsEn: Record FUN/INF, relay event time, source and quality.
Separately record mapped breaker position, gateway translation, outbound IEC104 IOA and COT.
bulletsId: Catat FUN/INF, waktu event relay, sumber dan kualitas.
Catat terpisah posisi breaker terpetakan, konversi gateway, IOA IEC104 keluar dan COT.

lab.scenarioEn: An IEC103 relay indicates a trip-start event; no breaker-position change is captured.
lab.scenarioId: Relay IEC103 menunjukkan event awal trip; perubahan posisi breaker tidak tertangkap.
stepsEn: The event is observed at the protection-function level.
The physical action is not observed and cannot be assumed.
stepsId: Event teramati pada level fungsi proteksi.
Aksi fisik tidak teramati dan tidak boleh diasumsikan.
lab.questionEn: What is the correct FAT verdict for breaker operation?
lab.questionId: Apa verdict FAT yang tepat untuk operasi breaker?
lab.answerEn: Trip event observed; breaker operation not proven. Add independent auxiliary-contact feedback before marking a physical state change.
lab.answerId: Event trip teramati; operasi breaker belum terbukti. Tambahkan feedback kontak bantu independen sebelum menandai perubahan status fisik.

sections.headingEn: FUN/INF mapping cannot be invented
paragraphsEn: When a protection relay emits a device-specific or generic data event, the field analyzer must preserve its raw FUN/INF and declare the mapping source. Guessing the human-readable name from another relay model makes an apparently readable but unsafe report.
If the event cannot be decoded confidently, record the raw ASDU, affected link, elapsed capture time and interoperability document required.
paragraphsId: Saat relay proteksi mengirim event data generik atau spesifik perangkat, analyzer harus mempertahankan FUN/INF mentah serta sumber mapping. Menebak nama sinyal dari model relay berbeda menghasilkan laporan yang tampak terbaca namun tidak aman.
Jika event belum dapat di-decode secara yakin, catat ASDU raw, link terkait, waktu capture dan dokumen interoperability yang diperlukan.
bulletsEn: A decoded numerical FUN/INF is not automatically a supported semantic label.
Use manufacturer/project-approved data points to complete translation.
bulletsId: FUN/INF numerik yang berhasil di-decode belum otomatis memiliki label semantik yang didukung.
Gunakan data point yang disetujui produsen/proyek untuk melengkapi terjemahan.

lab.scenarioEn: An unknown FUN/INF appears in an otherwise valid IEC103 ASDU.
lab.scenarioId: FUN/INF tidak dikenal muncul dalam ASDU IEC103 yang secara struktur valid.
stepsEn: Validity of the transfer and validity of the label are separate results.
Preserve the unknown identifier, never replace it with a plausible point name.
stepsId: Validitas transfer dan validitas nama sinyal merupakan hasil berbeda.
Simpan identitas yang belum dikenal, jangan menggantinya dengan nama point yang sekadar tampak masuk akal.
lab.questionEn: Should the engineer force it into a known breaker signal?
lab.questionId: Haruskah engineer memaksanya menjadi sinyal breaker yang dikenal?
lab.answerEn: No. Classify as valid transport/application envelope with unverified point semantics; obtain the approved relay profile.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Klasifikasikan envelope transport/aplikasi valid dengan semantik point belum terverifikasi; dapatkan profil relay resmi.

sections.headingEn: IEC103 to IEC104 report gap exercise
sections.headingId: Latihan gap report IEC103 menuju IEC104
paragraphsEn: An activity monitor shows an IEC103 source change, but the IEC104 SCADA receives no spontaneous ASDU. Check the relay ASDU, gateway ingestion, mapping to outgoing CA/IOA, event queue, COT selection and IEC104 active data-transfer state.
A successful IEC104 GI after a manual refresh could reflect a current snapshot, not delivery of the missing event.
paragraphsId: Activity monitor menunjukkan perubahan sumber IEC103, tetapi SCADA IEC104 tidak menerima ASDU spontan. Periksa ASDU relay, ingestion gateway, mapping CA/IOA keluar, antrian event, pemilihan COT dan status transfer data aktif IEC104.
GI IEC104 yang berhasil sesudah refresh manual bisa hanya mencerminkan snapshot terbaru, bukan pengiriman event yang hilang.
bulletsEn: Capture both source and outgoing gateway traces in the same time window.
Don't treat successful read-only data updates as reporting proof.
bulletsId: Capture trace sumber dan keluaran gateway pada interval sama.
Jangan menganggap pembaruan data read-only sukses sebagai bukti reporting.

lab.scenarioEn: The source event is observed, but only an IEC104 GI response appears downstream.
lab.scenarioId: Event sumber terlihat, tetapi hanya respons GI IEC104 yang muncul pada sisi hilir.
stepsEn: Source state changed; outgoing spontaneous event is not observed.
Investigate event generation and ownership before changing unrelated TCP timers.
stepsId: State sumber berubah; event spontan keluar tidak teramati.
Selidiki pembentukan event dan ownership sebelum mengubah timer TCP tak terkait.
lab.questionEn: Is spontaneous reporting verified?
lab.questionId: Apakah spontaneous reporting terverifikasi?
lab.answerEn: No. GI snapshot and spontaneous events exercise different delivery paths. Mark reporting not proven.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Snapshot GI dan event spontan melewati jalur delivery berbeda. Tandai reporting belum terbukti.

chapters.summaryId: Session TCP, frame I/S/U, urutan, GI, event spontan dan kontrol.
